items.stem: My brother ___ to school by bike every day.
items.analysis: 主语 My brother 是第三人称单数，every day 表示经常性、习惯性动作，须用一般现在时，动词加 -es 变为 goes。A 项 go 与主语不一致；C 项 is going 是现在进行时，表示此刻正在进行，与 every day 冲突；D 项 went 是过去时，与 every day 冲突。

items.stem: The earth ___ around the sun, and the moon ___ around the earth.
items.analysis: 地球绕太阳运行、月亮绕地球运行属于客观真理，无论说话时间如何都用一般现在时；两个主语 The earth、the moon 都是第三人称单数，故两空均用 moves。A 项用过去时，仿佛真理只适用于过去；C 项第一空用进行时，把永恒规律说成暂时动作；D 项第一空用完成时，均不符合客观真理的表达习惯。

items.stem: My sister ___ to work by bus every day.
items.analysis: 主语 my sister 是第三人称单数，一般现在时谓语加 -es；every day 是典型的一般现在时标志。

items.stem: — How often ___ your sister go to the library? — Twice a week.
items.analysis: How often 询问频率，答语 Twice a week 说明是习惯性动作，用一般现在时；go 是实义动词，主语 your sister 为第三人称单数，疑问句需借助 does，其后动词用原形 go。A 项 do 不能与单数主语搭配；C 项 is 不能直接与实义动词 go 连用；D 项 has 与句意不符，也不能构成一般现在时的疑问。

items.stem: The earth ___ around the sun.
items.analysis: 客观真理用一般现在时，主语 the earth 为第三人称单数，谓语用 moves。

items.stem: My father usually ___ (drink) a cup of tea after dinner.
items.analysis: 主语 My father 是第三人称单数，usually 表示习惯性动作，用一般现在时；drink 变为第三人称单数形式 drinks。若误填 is drinking，则把习惯说成此刻正在进行的动作，与 usually 冲突。

items.stem: Water ___ (boil) at 100°C.
items.analysis: 水的沸点是客观真理，用一般现在时；Water 是不可数名词，视为单数，动词加 -s，故填 boils。误填 is boiling 会把客观规律说成暂时现象。

items.stem: If it ___ tomorrow, the sports meeting will be put off.
items.analysis: if 引导条件状语从句，主句用一般将来时 will be put off，从句须用一般现在时表将来，即"主将从现"。B 项 will rain 在条件从句中属于时态冗余；C 项 rained 与 tomorrow 矛盾；D 项 has rained 强调动作已完成，与"明天"的将来条件不符。

items.stem: Neither of the two students ___ the answer to the question.
items.analysis: neither of + 复数名词作主语时，谓语动词通常用单数，故用 knows。A 项 know 是复数形式，与单数谓语要求不符；C 项 knowing 是非谓语动词，不能单独作谓语；D 项 are knowing 错在两处——know 是状态动词一般不用进行时，且谓语应为单数。

items.stem: — Where is your father? — He ___ in the garden. He ___ there every afternoon.
items.analysis: 第一空回答"你父亲在哪里"，强调此刻正在进行的动作，用现在进行时 is working；第二空 every afternoon 表示经常性习惯，用一般现在时 works。A、D 两项第一空用一般现在时，不能回答"此刻在哪里"；C 项第二空用进行时，与 every afternoon 表示的习惯相矛盾。

items.stem: Not only Tom but also his parents ___ interested in Chinese history.
items.analysis: not only...but also 连接两个并列主语时，谓语动词遵循就近原则，靠近谓语的 his parents 是复数，故用 are。A 项 is、D 项 was 都按单数处理，违反就近原则；C 项 has 不能与形容词 interested 搭配作谓语。

items.stem: I will call you as soon as I ___ at the airport.
items.analysis: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，主句用一般将来时 will call，从句须用一般现在时表将来。B 项 will arrive 在时间状语从句中属于时态冗余；C 项 arrived 与将来语境矛盾；D 项 am arriving 虽可表示已安排的将来，但在时间状语从句中习惯用一般现在时，且与主句时态不匹配。

items.stem: If he ___ (not come) tomorrow, we will start without him.
items.analysis: if 条件状语从句中用一般现在时表将来，不能用 will；否定需借助助动词 doesn't，后接动词原形 come，故填 doesn't come（也可写作 does not come）。误填 won't come 是条件从句中典型的"时态冗余"错误。

items.stem: Neither my parents nor my brother ___ (like) pop music.
items.analysis: neither...nor... 连接两个主语时，谓语遵循就近原则，靠近谓语的 my brother 是第三人称单数，故 like 加 -s，填 likes。误按 my parents 的复数形式填 like，是没有注意就近原则。

items.stem: 判断正误：He go to school by bike every day.
items.analysis: 主语 He 是第三人称单数，一般现在时的实义动词必须加 -s/-es，go 应改为 goes。原句 He go 是"主谓不一致"的典型错误，属于第三人称单数漏加词尾。

items.stem: 翻译句子：我妈妈每天六点起床，然后做早饭。
items.answer: My mother gets up at six every day and then makes breakfast.
items.analysis: 评分点：every day 决定用一般现在时；主语 My mother 是第三人称单数，get up 与 make 均需加 -s；"做早饭"用固定搭配 make breakfast，不用 do breakfast。若译成 My mother is getting up at six every day，时态与 every day 冲突。

items.stem: 翻译句子：老师告诉我们，光比声音传播得快。
items.answer: The teacher told us that light travels faster than sound.
items.analysis: 评分点：主句"告诉我们"是过去动作，用 told；宾语从句陈述客观真理，仍用一般现在时 travels，不能写成 travelled 或 would travel；"比……快"用比较级 faster than。

items.stem: The train ______ at 7:25 tomorrow morning, so we'd better set off at six.
items.analysis: 按时刻表、日程安排的将来动作，英语习惯用一般现在时表示，故 leaves 正确。left 与 has left 都指已经发生，与 tomorrow morning 矛盾；would leave 表过去将来，缺少过去时参照点。

items.stem: He usually ___ up at six, but this morning he ___ up at eight.
items.analysis: usually 表示习惯性动作，用一般现在时且主语为第三人称单数；this morning 的动作已完成，用一般过去时。

items.stem: Choose all the sentences in which the verb tense is used correctly.
options: She often goes shopping on Sundays.
My father is watching TV every evening.
The train leaves at eight tomorrow morning.
items.analysis: C 主谓不一致，应为 doesn't；D 中 every evening 表示习惯，不能用现在进行时；E 用一般现在时表示按时刻表安排的将来动作。

items.stem: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.analysis: 条件状语从句遵循'主将从现'，if 从句用一般现在时表示将来。

items.stem: There ___ a pen, two books and some paper on the desk.
items.analysis: there be 句型中有多个并列主语时，谓语与最靠近的主语保持一致（就近原则），a pen 是单数，故用 is。B 项 are 把三个并列成分当作整体复数，违反就近原则；C、D 两项错在 there be 句型的谓语只能是 be 动词，不能用 have/has。

items.stem: — Do you know when he ___ back? — Sorry, I don't. But I'll tell you when he ___ back.
items.analysis: 第一空 when 引导宾语从句，意为"他什么时候回来"，指将来要发生的动作，用 will come；第二空 when 引导时间状语从句，须用一般现在时表将来，用 comes。A 项第一空用一般现在时不能表达"将来何时"；C 项第二空 will come 违反"主将从现"；D 项两空都错。

items.stem: More than one student ___ late for class this morning because of the heavy rain.
items.analysis: more than one + 单数名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数；this morning 是明确的过去时间，故用 was。B 项 were 违反"more than one + 单数名词谓语用单数"的规则；C、D 两项用现在时，与 this morning 指过去矛盾。

items.stem: 判断正误：The teacher told us that the earth is round. 其中 is 应改为 was，因为主句是过去时。
items.analysis: 宾语从句表示客观真理时，时态不受主句影响，仍用一般现在时，is 无需改为 was。该句本身就是正确表达：主句用过去时 told，从句陈述永恒事实用 is，这一规则是"客观真理例外"的常考点。

items.stem: The teacher told us that light ___ faster than sound.
items.analysis: 宾语从句表示客观真理时，即使主句是过去时，从句仍用一般现在时。

items.stem: Fill in the blanks with the correct form of the verbs in brackets: (1) He ___ (not like) coffee at all. (2) The shop ___ (open) at nine every morning and ___ (close) at ten in the evening.
items.analysis: 第三人称单数的否定用 doesn't + 动词原形；描述固定作息用一般现在时，open、close 均加 -s。

items.stem: I ___ to the Great Wall with my parents last summer.
items.analysis: last summer 是明确的过去时间状语，句子叙述过去发生的动作，须用一般过去时，go 的过去式为 went。A 项一般现在时与 last summer 矛盾；C 项现在完成时不能与明确的过去时间连用；D 项将来时与过去时间状语矛盾。

items.stem: — When ___ you buy this dictionary? — Two years ago.
items.analysis: 答语 Two years ago 表明动作发生在过去，且 buy 是实义动词，疑问句需借助 did，其后动词用原形 buy。A 项 do 用于一般现在时，与过去时间矛盾；C 项 have 不能与 Two years ago 搭配；D 项 were 不能与实义动词原形连用。

items.stem: My uncle ______ to Beijing on business last Friday.
items.analysis: last Friday 是明确的过去时间状语，用一般过去时 flew（fly 的不规则过去式）；现在完成时不能与具体过去时间连用。

items.stem: She ___ her homework at home yesterday evening.
items.analysis: yesterday evening 是过去时间，用一般过去时；否定句需借助 didn't，其后动词必须用原形 do。A 项用现在时，与过去时间矛盾；C 项 didn't 后接了过去式 did，属"助动词后重复过去式"的典型错误；D 项现在完成时不能与明确过去时间连用。

items.stem: He ______ the window and jumped out of the room.
items.analysis: and 连接两个并列的过去动作，时态须一致；break 的过去式为 broke。

items.stem: Tom ___ (break) the window yesterday afternoon.
items.analysis: yesterday afternoon 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时；break 是不规则动词，过去式为 broke，不能写成 breaked。

items.stem: We ___ (have) a good time at the party last night.
items.analysis: last night 表示过去时间，用一般过去时；have 的过去式是 had。"have a good time"是固定搭配，意为"玩得开心"。

items.stem: He ___ in the countryside when he was a child, but now he lives in the city.
items.analysis: when he was a child 指明过去的时间背景，but now he lives in the city 与过去形成对比，故用一般过去时 lived。A、D 两项谈现在，与 when he was a child 矛盾；C 项现在完成时表示持续到现在，与"现在住在城里"矛盾。

items.stem: — Have you ever been to Beijing? — Yes. I ___ there in 2019.
items.analysis: 问句用现在完成时询问经历，答语 in 2019 是明确的过去时间，一旦出现具体过去时间就必须改用一般过去时 went。A 项现在完成时不能与 in 2019 连用；C 项 have gone 表示"去了还没回来"，与"去过北京"的经历义不符；D 项现在时与过去时间矛盾。

items.stem: The students ___ a class meeting last Friday afternoon.
items.analysis: last Friday afternoon 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时；hold 是不规则动词，过去式为 held。A 项现在时与过去时间矛盾；C 项现在完成时不能与明确过去时间连用；D 项进行时不能表示已结束的过去事件。

items.stem: It ___ heavily last night, so the roads are still wet.
items.analysis: last night 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时 rained；后半句 so the roads are still wet 说明过去动作对现在造成的结果，但时间状语决定了不能用现在完成时。A、D 两项用现在时，与 last night 矛盾；C 项现在完成时不能与 last night 这类明确过去时间连用。

items.stem: She ___ the book on the desk and ___ out of the room.
items.analysis: 第一空表示"把书放在桌上"，及物动词 lay（放置）的过去式是 laid，后接宾语 the book；第二空与 laid 并列，用 go 的过去式 went。A 项 lay 是 lie（躺）的过去式，lie 不及物，不能接宾语；C 项 gone 是过去分词，不能作谓语；D 项 lied 意为"撒谎"，词义不符。

items.stem: She ___ (not finish) her homework last night because she felt ill.
items.analysis: last night 表明用一般过去时；否定句需借助 did not，后接动词原形 finish，故填 didn't finish（也可写作 did not finish）。误填 doesn't finish 是时态错误，误填 didn't finished 是助动词后重复过去式的错误。

items.stem: The little boy ___ (fall) off his bike and hurt himself.
items.analysis: and 连接两个并列的过去动作，hurt 的过去式与原形同形，前面的 fall 也须用过去式 fell。fall off 意为"从……上摔下来"，是常见搭配。

items.stem: 判断正误：He didn't went to school yesterday.
items.analysis: 助动词 didn't 已承担过去时的标记，其后必须用动词原形，went 应改为 go。该句正确形式为 He didn't go to school yesterday，属"助动词后误用过去式"的高频错误。

items.stem: 翻译句子：上个周末我和朋友们去爬山了，我们玩得很开心。
items.answer: Last weekend I went climbing with my friends and we had a good time.
items.analysis: 评分点：Last weekend 决定用一般过去时，go 的过去式为 went；"去爬山"用 go climbing；"玩得开心"用 have a good time，须用过去式 had。若写成 have gone climbing 则时态与 Last weekend 冲突。

items.stem: 翻译句子：他昨天为什么没来上课？
items.answer: Why didn't he come to class yesterday?
items.analysis: 评分点：yesterday 决定用一般过去时；特殊疑问句语序为"疑问词 + did + 主语 + 动词原形"，故用 didn't he come，不能写成 didn't he came 或 Why he didn't come；"上课"用 come to class。

items.stem: — When ______ you ______ this bike? — Two years ago.
items.analysis: Two years ago 表明动作发生在过去，疑问句借助 did，其后动词用原形 buy；did 后接 bought 是常见错误。

items.stem: Nobody knows what ______ to him on his way home that evening.
items.analysis: that evening 指过去某一晚，宾语从句叙述过去发生的事，用一般过去时；主句 Nobody knows 的现在时不影响从句。

items.stem: Last Sunday my cousin ______ (teach) me how to swim in the river.
items.analysis: Last Sunday 是过去时间状语；teach 的过去式为 taught（不规则变化）。

items.stem: I didn't ___ the film last night because I ___ it twice before.
items.analysis: 第一空 didn't 后接动词原形 see；第二空动作发生在"昨晚没看电影"之前，即"过去的过去"，用过去完成时 had seen。A 项第二空用一般过去时，无法体现先后；C 项 didn't 后误用过去式 saw；D 项在 last night 的过去语境中用现在完成时，时态基准错误。

items.stem: There ___ a small river in front of our school, but now it has disappeared.
items.analysis: used to + 动词原形表示"过去常常、过去曾经"，there be 句型中应说 there used to be。B 项 there be 句型不能用 have 作谓语；C 项 was used to 意为"习惯于"，后面不能接 be；D 项 is used to doing 意为"习惯于做某事"，与"曾经有一条小河"的句意不符，且与 now 矛盾。

items.stem: — Where is Tom? — He ___ here a minute ago, but I don't know where he is now.
items.analysis: a minute ago 是明确过去时间，表示"一分钟前他还在这儿"，用一般过去时 was。A 项现在时与 a minute ago 矛盾；C 项现在完成时不能与 a minute ago 连用；D 项过去完成时需有另一个过去动作作参照，本句没有这样的参照点。

items.stem: — Has your father returned from Shanghai? — Yes. He ___ back yesterday afternoon.
items.analysis: 答语 yesterday afternoon 是明确过去时间，必须用一般过去时 came。A 项现在时与过去时间矛盾；C 项现在完成时不能与 yesterday afternoon 连用，这是"现在完成时 + 明确过去时间"的典型错误；D 项过去完成时缺少另一个过去时间作参照。

items.stem: 判断正误：I have seen the film last week.
items.analysis: last week 是明确的过去时间，与现在完成时不相容，应改为一般过去时 I saw the film last week。现在完成时只与表示不确定过去时间的状语（already、ever、never、just、yet）或表示持续时间的 for/since 短语连用。

items.stem: Which of the following sentences about the past are grammatically correct? (多选)
options: He has went to the library.
We didn't went there last week.
Did you see him last night?
They were watching TV at eight last night.
items.analysis: A 项 has went 形式错误，应为 has gone；C 项 didn't 后应用原形 go；B、D、E 三项时态与形式均正确。

items.stem: 判断：When he was young, he has visited many foreign countries. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: when he was young 限定过去时间，主句不能用现在完成时，应改为 visited；现在完成时不能与表示过去的时间状语或从句连用。

items.stem: We ___ a sports meeting next Friday.
items.analysis: next Friday 是将来时间状语，句子表示将来要发生的动作，用一般将来时 will have。A 项一般现在时不能单独表示将来；B 项过去时与 next Friday 矛盾；D 项现在完成时不能与将来时间连用。

items.stem: Look at the dark clouds! It ___ rain.
items.analysis: Look at the dark clouds 提供了"乌云密布"的现在迹象，be going to 表示根据现有迹象推断即将发生的事，主语 It 用 is。B 项过去时与 Look 的现在语境矛盾；C 项现在完成时不能表示对将来的推测；D 项一般现在时不能表示即将发生的天气变化。

items.stem: Don't worry. I ______ you with your homework after dinner.
items.analysis: will + 动词原形表示临时决定或对将来的承诺，after dinner 指向将来。

items.stem: — ___ you ___ me with my math this evening? — Sure.
items.analysis: this evening 指将来，请求对方帮忙用 Will you help...? 这一将来时的一般疑问句。B 项一般现在时不能表示将来的请求；C 项过去时与 this evening 矛盾；D 项现在完成时与 this evening 的将来义不符。

items.stem: Look at those black clouds! It ______ rain.
items.analysis: be going to 表示根据眼前迹象（乌云）作出的推测，Look 提示这是现在观察到的迹象。

items.stem: I ___ (call) you as soon as I arrive in Chengdu.
items.analysis: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，从句用一般现在时 arrive 表将来，主句用一般将来时，故填 will call（也可写作 I'll call）。误填 call 会使主句失去将来义。

items.stem: There ___ (be) a football match tomorrow afternoon.
items.analysis: tomorrow afternoon 是将来时间状语，there be 句型的将来形式为 there will be，故填 will be。误填 will have 是把 there be 与 have 混用，there be 句型不能用 have 作谓语。

items.stem: I ___ my grandparents this weekend. I have already bought the tickets.
items.analysis: this weekend 指将来，I have already bought the tickets 说明是事先计划好的安排，用 be going to 表示计划打算。A 项一般现在时不能表示个人计划；B 项过去时与 this weekend 矛盾；D 项现在完成时表示已完成，与"还没去"矛盾。

items.stem: If you don't hurry, you ___ the early bus.
items.analysis: if 条件从句用一般现在时 don't hurry，主句表示将来的结果，用一般将来时 will miss。A 项主句用一般现在时，无法表达"将会错过"；C 项过去时与将来语境矛盾；D 项现在完成时与"还没发生"矛盾。

items.stem: — Shall we go hiking tomorrow? — Good idea, but I ___ my homework first.
items.analysis: 对话谈的是明天的安排，but 引出说话人对将来的打算，"先做完作业"用一般将来时 will finish。A 项一般现在时在此不能表示个人将来的打算；C 项过去时与 tomorrow 矛盾；D 项现在进行时表将来通常用于已确定的安排，与 first 表示的先后打算不符。

items.stem: Don't worry. I ___ you as soon as I get the news.
items.analysis: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，从句用一般现在时 get 表将来，主句用一般将来时 will tell。A 项主句用一般现在时不能表示将来的承诺；C 项过去时与语境矛盾；D 项进行时不能表示将来的一次性动作。

items.stem: My father ___ back from Beijing in two days.
items.analysis: in two days 表示"两天后"，是典型的将来时间状语，用一般将来时 will come。A 项一般现在时不能表示将来的个人行程；B 项过去时与 in two days 矛盾；D 项现在完成时不能与表示将来的 in two days 连用。

items.stem: Look at the clouds. It ___ (rain) soon.
items.analysis: Look at the clouds 提供了现在的迹象，be going to 表示根据迹象推断即将发生，主语 It 用 is，故填 is going to rain。用 will rain 只表示单纯的将来，不能体现"有迹象"这一含义。

items.stem: We ___ (not go) out if it rains tomorrow.
items.analysis: if 条件从句用一般现在时 rains 表将来，主句用一般将来时；否定形式为 will not go，缩写为 won't go。误填 don't go 会使主句失去将来义。

items.stem: 判断正误：If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home.
items.analysis: if 引导条件状语从句时不能用一般将来时，须用一般现在时表将来，will rain 应改为 rains。该句正确形式为 If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home，属"主将从现"的典型错误。

items.stem: 翻译句子：下周日我们打算去参观博物馆。
items.answer: We are going to visit the museum next Sunday.
items.analysis: 评分点：next Sunday 决定用将来时；"打算"用 be going to do，主语 We 用 are；"参观"用 visit。也可译为 We will visit the museum next Sunday，但 be going to 更能体现"打算"。

items.stem: 翻译句子：如果明天不下雨，运动会将按时举行。
items.answer: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, the sports meeting will be held on time.
items.analysis: 评分点：if 条件从句用一般现在时 doesn't rain 表将来，主句用一般将来时；"运动会"与"举行"是被动关系，用 will be held；"按时"用 on time。若从句写成 if it won't rain，即违反主将从现。

items.stem: My plane ______ at ten tomorrow morning, so I have to get up early.
items.analysis: 按时刻表、日程安排发生的将来动作用一般现在时；主语 my plane 为第三人称单数，故用 leaves。

items.stem: We ______ dinner with the Smiths this Saturday. Would you like to join us?
items.analysis: 现在进行时可表示已经安排好的将来活动，this Saturday 说明这是计划中的事。

items.stem: According to the timetable, the last bus ______ (leave) at 21:30.
items.analysis: timetable 表明按时刻表运行，用一般现在时表将来；the last bus 为第三人称单数，故用 leaves。

items.stem: — Have you decided where to spend the holiday? — Yes. We ___ to Hainan next week.
items.analysis: next week 指将来，答语表示已经确定好的安排，用现在进行时 are going 表将来（go、come、leave、arrive 等位移动词常用进行时表将来）。A 项一般现在时不能表示个人安排；B 项现在完成时与 next week 矛盾；D 项过去时与 next week 矛盾。

items.stem: It is said that the new hospital ___ next year.
items.analysis: next year 指将来，hospital 与 build 是被动关系，故用一般将来时的被动语态 will be built。B 项一般现在时被动不能表示将来；C 项 builds 是主动形式且时态不对；D 项现在完成时主动形式既不能表示将来，也不符合被动关系。

items.stem: By the end of next month, we ___ the project.
items.analysis: by the end of + 将来时间作状语时，谓语表示"到将来某时为止已经完成"，用将来完成时 will have finished。A 项一般现在时无法体现"截止到将来某时"；B 项 will finish 只说明将来会完成，不能体现"到那时已完成"；D 项过去时与 next month 矛盾。

items.stem: I ___ him the truth as soon as he ___ back.
items.analysis: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，主句用一般将来时 will tell 表将来，从句用一般现在时 comes 表将来（主将从现）。A 项主句时态不能表示将来；C 项从句用 will come，违反主将从现；D 项主句与从句时态都用错。

items.stem: 判断正误：The plane takes off at 9:00 tomorrow. 句中用一般现在时表示按时刻表安排的将来动作。
items.analysis: 按时刻表、日程表准点发生的将来动作（航班、列车、课程、会议等）常用一般现在时表示，takes off 在此指"明天九点起飞"这一既定安排，故该说法正确。这类动词还有 leave、start、begin、arrive 等。

items.stem: Unless he ______ harder, he will fail the exam again.
items.analysis: unless 引导条件状语从句，主句为一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来（主将从现）。

items.stem: 判断：I will tell him the news as soon as he will come back. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: as soon as 引导时间状语从句，须用一般现在时表将来，应改为 comes back。

items.stem: Don't make any noise. My father ___ in the next room.
items.analysis: Don't make any noise 说明父亲此刻正在睡觉，用现在进行时 is sleeping。A 项一般现在时表示习惯，不能解释"别出声"的原因；C 项过去时与现在语境矛盾；D 项现在完成时表示已完成的动作，与"正在睡"不符。

items.stem: Listen! Someone ______ at the door.
items.analysis: Listen! 提示动作正在发生，用现在进行时 is knocking。

items.stem: — What were you doing at eight last night? — I ___ TV.
items.analysis: 问句用过去进行时 were you doing 询问过去某一时刻正在做什么，答语须保持一致，用 was watching。A 项现在时与 last night 矛盾；B 项一般过去时不能体现"八点那一刻正在进行"；D 项现在完成时与过去时间点不匹配。

items.stem: At nine last night, I ______ my homework in my room.
items.analysis: At nine last night 指过去某一时刻，用过去进行时 was doing。

items.stem: Listen! Someone ___ (sing) in the next room.
items.analysis: Listen! 提示动作此刻正在发生，用现在进行时；主语 someone 视为单数，be 动词用 is，故填 is singing。误填 sings 会把正在发生的动作说成习惯。

items.stem: They ___ (play) basketball at four yesterday afternoon.
items.analysis: at four yesterday afternoon 是过去的具体时刻，强调那时正在进行，用过去进行时；主语 They 是复数，be 动词用 were，故填 were playing。误填 played 只说明动作发生，不能体现"四点那一刻正在打"。

items.stem: While my mother ___ dinner, I ___ my homework.
items.analysis: while 引导的从句强调"在……期间"，两个动作同时持续进行，主从句都用过去进行时，故为 was cooking; was doing。A 项两个动作都用一般过去时，无法体现同时持续；C 项从句用一般过去时，与 while 的持续性不符；D 项第二空用现在完成时，时态基准错误。

items.stem: When the teacher came in, the students ___ loudly.
items.analysis: when 引导的从句用一般过去时 came in 表示突然发生的短暂动作，主句用过去进行时 were talking 表示当时正在进行的背景动作。A 项一般过去时不能体现"老师进来时正在讲话"；C 项现在完成时与过去语境不符；D 项现在时与过去时间矛盾。

items.stem: — Can I use your phone? — Sorry, I ___ it myself.
items.analysis: 对话发生在当下，拒绝的理由是"我自己正在用"，用现在进行时 am using。A 项一般现在时表示习惯，不能说明此刻不能借；C 项过去时与现在语境矛盾；D 项现在完成时表示已经用完，与拒绝借出的意思相反。

items.stem: My sister ___ her homework at nine last night.
items.analysis: at nine last night 是过去的具体时刻，强调那一刻正在进行的动作，用过去进行时 was doing。A 项现在时与过去时间矛盾；B 项一般过去时只说明动作发生，不能体现"九点那一刻正在做"；D 项现在完成时与过去时间点不匹配。

items.stem: The population of the city ___ all the time.
items.analysis: all the time 表示"一直在不断地"，强调变化正在进行的过程，用现在进行时 is growing。A 项一般现在时只陈述事实，不能体现"不断增长"的动态；B 项现在完成时强调已完成，与 all the time 的持续义不符；D 项过去时与 now 隐含的现在语境矛盾。

items.stem: While my father ___ (read) the newspaper, I was cleaning the room.
items.analysis: while 引导的从句表示背景动作，与主句 I was cleaning 同时进行，须用过去进行时；主语 my father 是单数，故填 was reading。误填 read 会破坏两个动作同时进行的对应关系。

items.stem: Look! It ___ (rain) outside. Take an umbrella with you.
items.analysis: Look! 提示此刻正在下雨，用现在进行时；主语 It 用 is，故填 is raining。误填 rains 表示气候习惯，不能解释"带把伞"的即时建议。

items.stem: 判断正误：I was knowing the answer.
items.analysis: know 是表示心理状态的静态动词，一般不用进行时，应改为 I knew the answer。类似的静态动词还有 like、want、belong、understand、have（拥有）等，它们通常只用一般时态。

items.stem: 翻译句子：昨天下午三点我正在图书馆看书。
items.answer: I was reading in the library at three yesterday afternoon.
items.analysis: 评分点："昨天下午三点"是过去的具体时刻，须用过去进行时 was reading，不能用 read 或 have read；"在图书馆"用 in the library。若译成 I read in the library at three yesterday afternoon，则失去"那一刻正在进行"的含义。

items.stem: 翻译句子：听！有人正在隔壁房间里弹钢琴。
items.answer: Listen! Someone is playing the piano in the next room.
items.analysis: 评分点：Listen! 提示用现在进行时；someone 视为单数，用 is playing；"弹钢琴"用 play the piano，乐器前要加定冠词 the；"隔壁房间"用 the next room。

items.stem: — Why are you standing at the door? — The soup ______ so delicious that I can't wait to taste it.
items.analysis: smell 在此是系动词，表示“闻起来”，属于状态，不用进行时，故用一般现在时 smells。问句用现在进行时只是描述此刻的动作，不能据此把答句也变成进行时；has smelled 表完成，was smelling 时态不符。

items.stem: — What ______ you ______ at this time yesterday? — I was watching a film.
items.analysis: at this time yesterday 指过去某一时刻，问句用过去进行时，结构为 were + 主语 + doing。

items.stem: She ______ a shower when the phone rang.
items.analysis: when the phone rang 表示过去某动作发生时另一动作正在进行，主句用过去进行时。

items.stem: While my mother ______ (cook), my father was cleaning the windows.
items.analysis: while 引导的从句表示过去正在进行的持续动作，用过去进行时，与主句 was cleaning 呼应。

items.stem: You ___ always ___ things about! Look at your room.
items.analysis: always 与现在进行时连用，表示说话人的不满或责备语气，故用 are always leaving。B 项现在完成时不能与 always 搭配表达责备；C 项过去时与 Look at your room 的现在语境矛盾；D 项一般现在时虽可与 always 连用，但只陈述习惯，失去了责备语气，且不能与 Look 的即时场景呼应。

items.stem: At nine last night, while I ___ TV, someone knocked at the door.
items.analysis: At nine last night 给出过去的具体时刻，while 强调"在此期间"动作持续进行，故用过去进行时 was watching；knocked 是插入的短暂动作。A 项一般过去时无法体现持续背景；C 项现在完成时与过去时间矛盾；D 项现在时与过去时间矛盾。

items.stem: At this time tomorrow, we ___ the exam.
items.analysis: At this time tomorrow 指将来某一具体时刻，强调那时正在进行，用将来进行时 will be taking。A 项现在时不能表示将来；B 项一般将来时只说明将来会考，不能体现"明天此时正在考"；D 项现在完成时与将来时间矛盾。

items.stem: The new bridge ___ now, so we have to take another road.
items.analysis: now 表示正在进行，bridge 与 build 是被动关系，故用现在进行时的被动语态 is being built。A 项 is building 是主动形式，桥不能自己建造；C 项现在完成时主动形式既不符合被动关系，也与 now 的进行义不符；D 项一般现在时不能表示正在施工。

items.stem: 判断正误：While I was walking home, I met an old friend. 句中过去进行时表示"我遇到老朋友时正在进行的动作"。
items.analysis: while 从句用过去进行时 was walking 表示较长的背景动作，主句用一般过去时 met 表示插入的短暂动作，两者构成"背景 + 突发事件"的典型搭配，故该说法正确。

items.stem: He ______ always ______ his things everywhere! It drives me crazy.
items.analysis: always 与现在进行时连用，表示反复发生并带有厌烦、抱怨等感情色彩。

items.stem: 判断：I was knowing the answer all the time. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: know 是表示心理状态的动词，一般不用进行时，应改为 knew。

items.stem: I ___ this book twice. It's very interesting.
items.analysis: twice 表示到现在为止的次数，强调经历对现在的影响（所以觉得有趣），用现在完成时 have read。A 项一般过去时不能表示"到现在为止"的累计次数；C 项过去进行时不能表示次数；D 项进行时与 twice 的完成义矛盾。

items.stem: — ___ you ever been to Mount Emei? — No, never.
items.analysis: ever 与 never 是现在完成时的典型标志，询问"到目前为止的经历"用 Have you ever been to...? A 项一般现在时不能询问经历；B 项一般过去时需搭配明确过去时间；D 项 Are 不能与 been 构成完成时。

items.stem: He ______ here since 2010.
items.analysis: since 2010 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成时 has worked。

items.stem: He ___ in this school since 2015.
items.analysis: since + 过去时间点表示动作从那时持续到现在，须用现在完成时 has taught。A 项一般现在时不能体现"从 2015 年至今"；B 项一般过去时表示动作已结束，与 since 的持续义矛盾；D 项现在进行时不能表示长久持续的状态。

items.stem: He hasn't finished his homework ______, so he can't go out to play.
items.analysis: yet 用于否定句和疑问句末，表示“还（没）”；already 多用于肯定句。

items.stem: I ___ (not see) him for a long time.
items.analysis: for a long time 表示持续到现在的一段时间，用现在完成时；否定形式为 have not seen，缩写为 haven't seen。误填 didn't see 与 for a long time 的持续义矛盾。

items.stem: She ___ (live) in Shanghai since she was born.
items.analysis: since she was born 表示从出生到现在，用现在完成时；主语 She 是第三人称单数，故填 has lived。误填 lives 不能体现"从过去持续到现在"的累计。

items.stem: They ___ here for nearly ten years.
items.analysis: for + 一段时间表示持续到现在，须用现在完成时 have lived。A、D 两项用现在时，不能体现"已经住了近十年"的累计；B 项一般过去时表示过去住过、现在不一定住，与 for 的持续义矛盾。

items.stem: — Have you finished your work? — Not yet. I ___ it.
items.analysis: Not yet 说明工作尚未完成，此刻仍在做，用现在进行时 am doing。B 项一般过去时与 Not yet 矛盾；C 项现在完成时表示已完成，与 Not yet 直接冲突；D 项过去进行时与当前的对话语境不符。

items.stem: My father ___ the car. It looks new now.
items.analysis: 后句 It looks new now 说明洗车这一过去动作对现在造成的结果，用现在完成时 has washed。A 项一般现在时不能表示已完成的结果；B 项一般过去时不强调对现在的影响；D 项进行时表示正在洗，与"现在看起来像新的"矛盾。

items.stem: — When ___ you ___ this bike? — Three years ago.
items.analysis: when 询问具体的过去时间，答语 Three years ago 也是明确过去时间，须用一般过去时 did you buy。A 项现在完成时不能与明确过去时间连用；C 项现在时与过去时间矛盾；D 项过去完成时缺少另一个过去时间作参照。

items.stem: This is the best film I ___ ever ___.
items.analysis: "This is the + 最高级 + 名词 + that/省略关系词 + 主语 + have/has ever done"是固定句型，表示"这是我曾看过的最……的"，故用 have ever seen。B 项过去完成时需有过去参照点；C 项一般过去时不能与 ever 的"至今经历"义搭配；D 项将来时与句意矛盾。

items.stem: He ___ (be) to Beijing three times.
items.analysis: three times 表示到现在为止的次数，用现在完成时；"去过某地"用 have/has been to，主语 He 用 has，故填 has been。误填 has gone to 表示"去了还没回来"，与"去过三次"的经历义不符。

items.stem: We ___ (not finish) the work yet.
items.analysis: yet 用于否定句和疑问句，是现在完成时的标志词，表示"到现在还没完成"，故填 haven't finished（也可写作 have not finished）。误填 didn't finish 会失去"到现在为止"的含义。

items.stem: 判断正误：I have seen him yesterday. 句中现在完成时与 yesterday 连用是正确的。
items.analysis: yesterday 是明确的过去时间，与现在完成时不相容，应改为 I saw him yesterday。现在完成时只能与不确定的过去时间状语（ever、never、already、yet、just）或 for/since 引导的持续时间连用。

items.stem: 翻译句子：我已经在这个城市住了十年了。
items.answer: I have lived in this city for ten years.
items.analysis: 评分点："已经……了"表示持续到现在，用现在完成时 have lived；"十年"是时间段，用 for ten years，不能用 since ten years（since 后接时间点）。若译成 I lived in this city for ten years，则暗示现在已不住在这里。

items.stem: 翻译句子：你曾经去过长城吗？
items.answer: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?
items.analysis: 评分点：ever 是现在完成时的标志词，询问经历用 Have you ever been to...?；"去过某地"用 have been to，不能用 have gone to（表示去了未归）；"长城"译为 the Great Wall，须加定冠词。

items.stem: Great changes ______ in my hometown in the past ten years.
items.analysis: in the past ten years 表示从过去到现在的一段时间，用现在完成时；take place 为不及物动词短语，无被动语态。

items.stem: It is the first time that I ______ such a beautiful city.
items.analysis: It is the first time that... 结构中，从句用现在完成时。

items.stem: My sister ______ (learn) English for six years, and she can speak it well now.
items.analysis: for six years 表示持续到现在的时间段，用现在完成时 has learned（英式亦作 has learnt）。

items.stem: It is three years since he ___ to Chengdu.
items.analysis: "It is + 一段时间 + since + 从句"句型中，since 从句用一般过去时，主句用一般现在时或现在完成时，故填 came。B 项 since 从句用现在完成时是典型错误；C 项现在时与 since 的"自过去某时起"矛盾；D 项过去完成时缺少参照点。

items.stem: The old man ___ for two years.
items.analysis: for two years 表示持续一段时间，die 是瞬间动词，不能与时间段连用，须改用表示状态的 be dead，即 has been dead。A 项 has died 是"瞬间动词 + 时间段"的典型错误；B 项一般过去时与 for two years 的持续义矛盾；D 项过去时同样不能表示持续到现在。

items.stem: — Where is your brother? — He ___ to the library. He ___ there an hour ago.
items.analysis: 第一空 has gone to 表示"去了某地，人还没回来"，与"他现在在哪儿"的提问吻合；第二空 an hour ago 是明确过去时间，用一般过去时 went。B 项 has been to 表示"去过已回来"，与人不在场矛盾；C 项第一空用过去时不能说明现在不在；D 项第二空与 an hour ago 冲突。

items.stem: I ___ him since we ___ at a party in 2010.
items.analysis: 主句用 since 表示"从过去某时一直到现在"，须用现在完成时 have known；since 从句表示过去的时间起点，用一般过去时 met。A 项主句时态不能体现持续到现在；C 项 since 从句误用现在完成时；D 项过去完成时缺少过去参照点。

items.stem: 判断正误：He has been in the army for five years. 句中 has been 表示从过去开始并持续到现在的状态。
items.analysis: 现在完成时的"延续用法"表示动作或状态从过去开始、持续到现在，常与 for + 时间段、since + 时间点连用；has been in the army 意为"参军五年了"，状态延续至今，故该说法正确。注意不能用 has joined（瞬间动词）。

items.stem: Since he graduated from college, he ______ in three different companies.
items.analysis: since 引导的时间状语从句用一般过去时，主句表示从过去持续到现在的动作，用现在完成时。

items.stem: 判断：He has joined the army for three years. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: join 是短暂性动词，不能与表示持续时间的 for three years 连用，应改为 has been in the army for three years。

items.stem: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ______.
items.analysis: By the time + 一般过去时，主句动作发生在“过去的过去”，用过去完成时 had begun。

items.stem: She told me that she ______ the book before.
items.analysis: 主句 told 为过去时，宾语从句中“读书”发生在其之前，用过去完成时。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: By the time the ambulance arrived, the injured man ______ (lose) a lot of blood.
items.analysis: by the time 从句用一般过去时 arrived，主句的“失血”发生在救护车到达之前并已造成结果，用过去完成时 had lost。

items.stem: In 'When I arrived at the hall, the meeting had begun', 'had begun' shows that the meeting started before my arrival.
items.analysis: 过去完成时表示“过去的过去”。had begun 以 arrived 为参照点，说明会议在我到达之前就已经开始，判断正确。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with the past perfect tense: 等我到达火车站时，火车已经开走了。
items.answer: By the time I got to the railway station, the train had already left.
items.analysis: by the time 引导的从句用一般过去时 got，主句用过去完成时 had left，already 置于 had 与过去分词之间，准确表达“过去的过去”。

items.stem: By the time we ______ the station, the train ______.
items.analysis: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般过去时 got 表示“到达”这一过去动作；火车开走发生在到达之前，是“过去的过去”，主句用过去完成时 had left。B 项把两个动作的先后弄反；C 项 has left 是现在完成时，参照点是现在，与 got 的过去语境冲突；D 项两个动作都用过去完成时，抹掉了先后关系。

items.stem: It was the first time that he ______ abroad, so everything seemed new to him.
items.analysis: It was the first time that... 句型中主句为过去时，从句须用过去完成时，表示“到那个过去时刻为止的第一次经历”，故用 had been。若主句改为 It is the first time，从句才用现在完成时 has been；was 只是一般过去时，无法体现“截至那时”的完成意义。

items.stem: When I got to the cinema, the film ______ for ten minutes.
items.analysis: for ten minutes 表示一段时间，谓语必须是延续性动词；begin 是短暂动词，不能与 for 连用，“开演”这一状态的延续要用 be on。电影在我到达之前就已开演，故用过去完成时 had been on。has been on 的参照点是现在，与 got 不一致；began 既不能接 for ten minutes，也没有体现“过去的过去”。

items.stem: No sooner ______ down than the telephone rang.
items.analysis: no sooner...than... 意为“一……就……”，固定搭配过去完成时；no sooner 置于句首时句子要部分倒装，把助动词 had 提到主语之前，故为 had he sat。B、D 两项没有倒装；C 项用一般过去时，破坏了 no sooner...than 的时态要求。

items.stem: He told me that he ______ the novel twice before he wrote the report.
items.analysis: 主句 told 是过去时，宾语从句中“读小说”发生在 wrote the report 之前，属于“过去的过去”，须用过去完成时 had read。read 的过去式与原形同形，是本题最易误选的干扰项；has read 以现在为参照，would read 表过去将来，都与句意不符。

items.stem: By the end of last term, we ______ more than 2,000 English words.
items.analysis: by the end of + 过去时间，表示“到过去某一时刻为止”，句子须用过去完成时 had learned。learned 只是一般过去时，无法体现“截止到那时已完成”的累计意义；have learned 的参照点是现在，与 last term 矛盾。

items.stem: He ______ in that factory for five years before he became a teacher.
items.analysis: before 从句用一般过去时 became，主句动作 work 在此之前已持续五年，用过去完成时 had worked。worked 会与 became 同时，先后的时间层次消失；has worked 参照现在；works 是一般现在时，与整个过去语境矛盾。

items.stem: It was reported that the bridge ______ ten years before.
items.analysis: 主句 was reported 为过去时，宾语从句中桥的建造又早十年，是“过去的过去”，须用过去完成时的被动语态 had been built（before 在此是副词，意为“在此之前”）。was built 失去时间层次；has been built 以现在为参照；would be built 表将来，与 ten years before 矛盾。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: She told me that she ______ (never, be) to the Great Wall before.
items.analysis: 宾语从句的动作在主句 told 之前，用过去完成时；never 放在 had 与过去分词之间；have been to 表示“去过某地”，此处须用其过去完成形式 had been to。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: It was the third time that he ______ (visit) the science museum.
items.analysis: It was the third time that... 句型中主句为过去时，从句用过去完成时 had visited；若主句改为 It is the third time，从句则用现在完成时 has visited。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: Before he retired last year, Mr. Wang ______ (teach) in that village school for thirty years.
items.analysis: retire 是过去动作，教书的三十年在此前已持续并结束，用过去完成时 had taught；for thirty years 表示截至退休时的时间长度，不能与一般现在时或现在完成时搭配。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with the past perfect tense: 他说他前一天已经把报告写完了。
items.answer: He said that he had finished the report the day before.
items.analysis: 主句 said 为过去时，从句动作更早，用过去完成时 had finished；“前一天”在过去语境中译作 the day before，不能用 yesterday。

items.stem: She told me that she ______ the letter the day before, so I needn't worry.
items.analysis: 主句 told 是过去时，从句动作发生在“过去的过去”，且 the day before 明确指更早的时间，须用过去完成时 had sent。sent 不能体现先后；has sent 是现在完成时，与过去时主句冲突；would send 表过去将来。

items.stem: When I got to the station, I found that I ______ my ticket at home.
items.analysis: “把票忘在家里”发生在 found 之前，属“过去的过去”，用过去完成时 had left。

items.stem: It was the third time that he ______ late for class that week.
items.analysis: It was the third time that... 结构中，从句用过去完成时。

items.stem: Before he came to China, he ______ (study) Chinese for two years.
items.analysis: “学汉语”发生在 came 之前，用过去完成时 had studied。

items.stem: She was late for the meeting because she ______ her keys at home.
items.analysis: “迟到”是过去的事，把钥匙忘在家里发生在迟到之前，是“过去的过去”，用 had left。leave sth. at home 是固定搭配，“把某物忘在某处”。left 会与 was late 并列为同时发生的动作，逻辑上讲不通；has left 以现在为参照，与 was 不一致。

items.stem: The thief ______ before the police arrived at the shop.
items.analysis: 小偷逃跑发生在警察到达之前，两个过去动作有明确先后，先发生的用过去完成时 had run away。ran away 会与 arrived 同时；was running away 强调“正在逃跑”，与 before 所表示的完成关系不符；has run away 以现在为参照点。

items.stem: I didn't watch the film last night because I ______ it twice.
items.analysis: “没看电影”是过去的事，而“看过两遍”在此之前已经完成，用过去完成时 had already seen，already 常与完成时连用。already saw 与完成意义不符；have already seen 的参照点是现在，与 didn't watch 的过去语境不一致；was seeing 表正在进行。

items.stem: A past perfect sentence can stand alone with a definite past time adverbial, as in 'He had left yesterday.'
items.analysis: 过去完成时必须有另一个过去时间或过去动作作参照点，不能像一般过去时那样单独与 yesterday 这类确定的过去时间状语连用。该句应改为 He left yesterday.；若要保留过去完成时，须补出参照点，如 He had left before I got there yesterday.

items.stem: Which of the following sentences about the past perfect tense are grammatically correct? (多选)
options: By the time he arrived, the train had left.
She said she has finished the work.
I had already eaten when he called me.
He had went home before I came.
They had lived there for ten years before they moved.
items.analysis: B 项主句为过去时 said，从句应改为 had finished；D 项 had went 形式错误，应为 had gone；A、C、E 三项正确。

items.stem: 判断：When we got to the theatre, the play has already begun. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: “演出开始”发生在 got 之前，应用过去完成时 had already begun，不能用现在完成时。

items.stem: He usually ______ to school by bike, but today he ______ a bus.
items.analysis: usually 表示习惯，用一般现在时；but today 表示暂时情况，用现在进行时 is taking。

items.stem: My father ______ TV when I got home.
items.analysis: got home 是过去某一时刻，主句表示当时正在进行的动作，用过去进行时。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: If he ______ (come) tomorrow, I will tell him the truth.
items.analysis: if 引导真实条件句，主句为一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来（主将从现），主语 he 为第三人称单数，故填 comes。

items.stem: In 'I will call you when I get there', the verb in the time clause is in the simple present because the clause refers to the future.
items.analysis: when 引导时间状语从句，主句为一般将来时，从句用一般现在时表将来，即“主将从现”，判断正确。

items.stem: — The phone is ringing. — I ______ it.
items.analysis: 说话瞬间临时决定去做某事，用 will + 动词原形，故 will get。be going to 强调事先打算；一般现在时 get 表示习惯或安排；got 是过去时，与正在响铃的语境不符。

items.stem: We won't start the meeting until everyone ______ here.
items.analysis: not...until 引导时间状语从句，主句为将来时，从句用一般现在时 is 表将来，这是主将从现的典型结构。will be 违反该规则；was 是过去时；has been 是现在完成时，与“等人到齐”这一将要实现的情况不符。

items.stem: — Where is Tom? — He ______ to the library. He will be back in an hour.
items.analysis: has gone to 表示“已经去了某地（人现在不在这里）”，与问句 Where is Tom? 以及“一小时后回来”完全吻合。has been to 表示“去过某地（已回来）”，人应在现场，与问句矛盾；went 不能说明现在不在此地；is going 表正在进行，与 will be back 不搭。

items.stem: The teacher told us that the earth ______ around the sun.
items.analysis: 宾语从句表示客观真理、自然规律时，不受主句过去时 told 的影响，仍用一般现在时 moves，这是时态呼应原则的例外。moved、had moved、would move 都是机械套用“主句过去、从句也过去”的错误。

items.stem: I ______ this novel twice. It is really worth reading.
items.analysis: twice 表示“到现在为止的累计次数”，用现在完成时 have read。read 的过去式与原形同形，是最易误选的干扰项，但一般过去时必须搭配明确的过去时间；had read 缺少过去的参照点；am reading 与 twice 矛盾。

items.stem: When I was a child, I ______ swimming in the river every summer.
items.analysis: When I was a child 与 every summer 一起表示过去反复发生的习惯，用一般过去时 went。go 是现在时；have gone 表示“已去未回”，不能表示习惯；was going 表过去正在进行，与 every summer 的反复意义冲突。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: She ______ (live) in Chengdu since she graduated from college.
items.analysis: since 引导的时间状语从句用一般过去时 graduated，主句表示从那时持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时 has lived。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: Don't get off the bus until it ______ (stop).
items.analysis: until 引导时间状语从句，主句为祈使句（表将来），从句用一般现在时表将来，主语 it 为第三人称单数，故填 stops。

items.stem: 'He has joined the army for two years.' is a correct sentence.
items.analysis: join 是短暂动词，不能与 for two years 这样的时间段连用。应改为 He has been in the army for two years. 或 He joined the army two years ago.，这是完成时与延续性动词搭配的常见错误。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
items.answer: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we will go climbing.
items.analysis: 真实条件句遵循主将从现：if 从句用一般现在时 doesn't rain 表将来，主句用一般将来时 will go。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English: 自从他来到这所学校，他已经教了十年英语。
items.answer: Since he came to this school, he has taught English for ten years.
items.analysis: since 从句用一般过去时 came 表示起点，主句用现在完成时 has taught，配合 for ten years 表示持续至今的时间段。

items.stem: You look so tired. ______ you ______ all night?
items.analysis: 现在完成进行时表示动作从过去持续到现在，并强调对现在的影响（所以“你看上去很累”），故用 Have; been working。一般过去时只陈述过去事实，与现在的状态联系不紧；过去完成时缺少过去参照点；一般现在时不能表示持续至今。

items.stem: — Where is Tom? — He ______ to the library. He ______ there ten minutes ago.
items.analysis: has gone to 表示“去了某地（未回）”，与 Where is Tom 呼应；ten minutes ago 是过去时间，用一般过去时 went。

items.stem: We ______ each other since we were children.
items.analysis: since 从句用一般过去时，主句表示持续到现在的状态，用现在完成时 have known。

items.stem: Don't get off the bus until it ______ (stop).
items.analysis: until 引导时间状语从句，主句为祈使句表将来，从句用一般现在时 stops。

items.stem: — Have you finished the report? — Yes, I ______ it a moment ago.
items.analysis: a moment ago 是明确的过去时间状语，只能与一般过去时连用，故用 finished。现在完成时不能与 ago 这类具体过去时间连用，这是本题的核心考点；had finished 需要一个过去的参照点；was finishing 表正在进行。

items.stem: It is the first time that I ______ to this city, so I know nothing about it.
items.analysis: It is the first time that... 句型中主句为现在时，从句用现在完成时 have been。若主句改为 It was the first time，从句才用过去完成时 had been，这正是与过去完成时的辨析点；was 无法表达“到目前为止的第一次”。

items.stem: It is three years since he ______ to work in Shanghai.
items.analysis: It is + 时间段 + since 从句，从句用一般过去时，表示动作的起点，故用 came。since 从句不用现在完成时 has come，也不用一般现在时 comes；had come 缺少过去参照点。

items.stem: Hardly had I got home when it ______ to rain.
items.analysis: hardly...when... 结构中主句用过去完成时（had got），when 从句用一般过去时，表示紧接着发生的动作，故用 began。had begun 会造成两个过去完成时并列，失去先后层次；has begun 与过去语境矛盾。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: It was not until he ______ (take) off his glasses that I recognized him.
items.analysis: 这是 not until 的强调句型 It was not until...that...，until 从句用一般过去时 took，与主句 recognized 保持一致，不能用过去完成时。

items.stem: By the time you get home tonight, I ______ dinner for you.
items.analysis: by the time 引导的时间状语从句用一般现在时表将来（get），主句动作在这一将来时间之前完成，用将来完成时 will have prepared。have prepared 缺将来参照；prepared 与 tonight 矛盾；would prepare 需要过去时语境。

items.stem: He ______ in the army for three years before he went to college.
items.analysis: “服役”发生在 went to college 之前，用过去完成时 had served。

items.stem: 判断：If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay at home. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: if 引导条件状语从句，主句为一般将来时，从句须用一般现在时，应改为 rains。

items.stem: The classroom ______ every day by the students on duty.
items.analysis: classroom 与 clean 是被动关系，every day 表经常，用一般现在时的被动语态 is cleaned。

items.stem: English ______ in more than seventy countries around the world.
items.analysis: English 是被“说”的对象，句子陈述客观事实，用一般现在时的被动语态 is spoken。speaks 与 is speaking 都是主动形式，English 不能自己说话；has spoken 是主动的现在完成时。

items.stem: The window ______ by Tom yesterday afternoon.
items.analysis: window 与 break 是被动关系，yesterday afternoon 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时的被动语态 was broken。broke 是主动形式；is broken 是现在时；has been broken 是现在完成时，不能与 yesterday afternoon 连用。

items.stem: A new hospital ______ in our town last year.
items.analysis: hospital 与 build 是被动关系，last year 表过去，用一般过去时的被动语态 was built。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: Rice ______ (grow) in the south of China.
items.analysis: rice 与 grow 是被动关系，句子陈述一般事实，用一般现在时的被动语态 is grown。

items.stem: The classroom ______ every day, so it always looks clean.
items.analysis: classroom 与 clean 是被动关系，every day 表示现在的经常性动作，用一般现在时的被动语态 is cleaned。cleans 是主动形式，教室不能自己打扫；is cleaning 是现在进行时；was cleaned 是过去时，与 every day 和 always 矛盾。

items.stem: A new hospital ______ in our city next year.
items.analysis: hospital 是被建造的对象，next year 表将来，用一般将来时的被动语态 will be built。will build 是主动形式；is built 是一般现在时被动；has been built 是现在完成时被动，都与 next year 矛盾。

items.stem: The bridge ______ now, so we have to take a boat to cross the river.
items.analysis: now 表示动作正在进行，桥是被建造的对象，用现在进行时的被动语态 is being built。is built 表经常性；has been built 表已经建成，与“只能坐船过河”矛盾；is building 是主动形式。

items.stem: The work must ______ before Friday, or we will miss the deadline.
items.analysis: 情态动词 must 之后接动词原形，work 与 finish 是被动关系，故用“must + be + 过去分词”即 must be finished。finish 与 be finishing 是主动形式；finished 缺了 be，不能构成被动。

items.stem: This kind of book ______ well in that shop because it is cheap and useful.
items.analysis: sell 在此表示“卖得（好）”，是主动形式表被动意义的固定用法，主语 this kind of book 为单数，故用 sells。is sold well 不符合英语习惯；are sold 主谓不一致；sell 与单数主语不一致。同类用法还有 The pen writes smoothly.、The cloth washes well.

items.stem: The children ______ by their grandmother when their parents are at work.
items.analysis: look after 是“动词+介词”的短语动词，变被动时介词必须保留，故为 are looked after。are looked 丢掉了介词 after；look after 与 are looking after 都是主动形式，孩子不能照顾自己。

items.stem: My bike is broken. It needs ______ this afternoon.
items.analysis: need 表示“需要”时可接动名词，且动名词主动形式表被动意义，即 need doing = need to be done，故用 repairing。to repair 会变成“自行车去修别人”；repaired 与 being repaired 都不能跟在 need 之后表达此义。同类还有 want/require doing。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: A new library ______ (build) in our school at the moment.
items.analysis: at the moment 表示此刻正在进行，library 是被建造的对象，用现在进行时的被动语态 is being built。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: The letter ______ (must, send) to him before he leaves.
items.analysis: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形，letter 与 send 是被动关系，故用 must be sent；send sth. to sb. 变为被动后 to him 保留。

items.stem: 'The accident was happened at midnight.' is a correct sentence.
items.analysis: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态，不能说 was happened。应改为 The accident happened at midnight.。类似的还有 occur、rise、take place、break out 等。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with the passive voice: 这座桥是十年前建成的。
items.answer: This bridge was built ten years ago.
items.analysis: 桥是被建造的对象，ten years ago 是明确的过去时间，用一般过去时的被动语态 was built。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with the passive voice: 会议将在明天下午举行。
items.answer: The meeting will be held tomorrow afternoon.
items.analysis: meeting 与 hold 是被动关系，tomorrow afternoon 表将来，用一般将来时的被动语态 will be held。

items.stem: The problem ______ at the meeting now.
items.analysis: now 表正在进行，problem 与 discuss 是被动关系，用现在进行时的被动语态 is being discussed。

items.stem: This kind of book ______ well and ______ by young people.
items.analysis: sell 表示“畅销”时用主动形式表被动；book 与 like 是被动关系，用 is liked。

items.stem: The bridge ______ (repair) at the moment, so we have to take another road.
items.analysis: at the moment 表正在进行，bridge 与 repair 是被动关系，用现在进行时的被动语态 is being repaired。

items.stem: He was made ______ the truth by the police.
items.analysis: 主动语态 make sb. do sth. 中省略 to，变为被动语态后必须把 to 还原，即 be made to do sth.，故用 to tell。tell 是忘记还原 to 的常见错误；telling 与 told 都不能用于该结构。同类动词还有 see、hear、let（let 被动仍不带 to）。

items.stem: The piano ______ by my sister at this time yesterday.
items.analysis: at this time yesterday 表示过去某一时刻正在进行，piano 是被弹的对象，用过去进行时的被动语态 was being played。was played 只表过去发生；is being played 是现在进行时被动；has been played 是现在完成时被动，均与过去的时间点不符。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: By the end of last year, more than 500 trees ______ (plant) on the hill.
items.analysis: by the end of last year 表示“到去年年底为止”，用过去完成时；trees 是被栽种的对象，故用过去完成时的被动语态 had been planted。

items.stem: In 'The book is well written', 'written' forms part of a passive voice structure rather than a predicative.
items.analysis: 该句是“系动词 be + 过去分词”构成的系表结构，well written 说明书的特征，相当于形容词，不是被动语态；被动语态强调动作，通常可加 by 短语或与时间状语搭配，如 The book was written by him in 2020.

items.stem: Mr. Li is said ______ to Canada last year, but nobody knows exactly when he left.
items.analysis: be said to do 是固定被动结构，不定式的动作发生在谓语 is said 之前（last year），须用不定式完成式 to have gone。to go 表同时或将来；going 不能作主语补足语；to be going 表将来进行，均与去年已发生矛盾。

items.stem: The old man ______ to hospital at once, or he will be in danger.
items.analysis: old man 与 send 是被动关系，情态动词 must 后接 be + 过去分词，构成 must be sent。

items.stem: 判断：The accident was happened last night. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: happen 是不及物动词，没有被动语态，应改为 The accident happened last night。

items.stem: You ______ hand in your homework on time, or the teacher will be angry.
items.analysis: must 表示“必须”；or 引出的后果说明这是义务要求，needn't（不必）、can't（不能）与语境矛盾。

items.stem: ______ you like to have another cup of tea?
items.analysis: Would you like to do sth.? 是提出邀请、征求意见的固定句型。Do you like to do sth.? 询问习惯爱好，与“再来一杯”的即时邀请不符；Will you like 不用于礼貌邀请；Should 表“应该”，语气不当。

items.stem: The lights in his room are on and his car is in the garage, so he ______ be at home now.
items.analysis: must 表示有把握的肯定推测，意为“一定”，与“灯亮着、车在车库”的证据吻合。can 表推测只用于否定句和疑问句（can't）；need 与 dare 作情态动词时不表示推测。

items.stem: ______ you please open the door for me?
items.analysis: Would you please...? 是委婉请求的固定句式。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: You had better ______ (not, stay) up too late before the exam.
items.analysis: had better 后接动词原形，其否定式是 had better not do sth.，not 置于 better 之后、动词之前，故填 not stay。

items.stem: — Must I hand in the homework today? — No, you ______. You can hand it in tomorrow.
items.analysis: must 引导的一般疑问句，否定回答用 needn't 或 don't have to，表示“不必”；mustn't 意为“禁止”，语气与“明天交也可以”矛盾。can't 表“不能”，shouldn't 表“不应该”，都不符合语境。

items.stem: You ______ smoke here. Look at the sign—'No Smoking'.
items.analysis: mustn't 表示“禁止、不许”，与禁烟标志相符。needn't 是“不必”，wouldn't 是“不愿”，couldn't 是“不能（能力/推测）”，都不能表达规章制度的禁止。

items.stem: She ______ be in the office. I saw her go out just now.
items.analysis: 情态动词表否定推测用 can't，意为“不可能”，与“我刚看见她出去”吻合。mustn't 表禁止；needn't 表不必；shouldn't 表不应该，都不能表示推测。

items.stem: The ground is wet. It ______ have rained last night.
items.analysis: must have done 表示对过去情况的肯定推测，意为“一定做过”，与“地面是湿的”这一证据相符。can have done 只用于否定或疑问；should have done 意为“本该做而未做”；need 不与 have done 构成这种推测。

items.stem: ______ I use your dictionary for a moment? I can't find mine.
items.analysis: May I...? 用于礼貌地请求许可。Must I...? 问“必须吗”，Need I...? 问“有必要吗”，Should I...? 问“应该吗”，都不能表示请求对方允许。

items.stem: He ______ have finished the work, but I'm not sure.
items.analysis: may have done 表示对过去的推测，把握不大，与 but I'm not sure 一致。must have done 表示有把握的肯定推测，与“不确定”矛盾；can have done 不用于肯定句；should have done 意为“本该做”，与句意无关。

items.stem: We ______ get up early when we were in the countryside.
items.analysis: used to do 表示“过去常常做（现在不了）”，与 when we were in the countryside 吻合。are used to 后接动名词，表“习惯于”；use to 缺少过去式标记，不能表示过去习惯；used 单独使用不能带 get up。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with a proper modal verb: — Must I finish the report now? — No, you ______. You may hand it in on Friday.
items.analysis: must 提问时否定回答用 needn't（或 don't have to），表示“不必”；不能用 mustn't，因为 mustn't 意为“禁止”。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: It's already ten o'clock. He ______ (must, be) at home now.
items.analysis: must 表肯定推测，后接动词原形；at home 是介词短语作表语，故用 must be，意为“一定在家”。

items.stem: The negative answer to 'Must I finish it today?' is 'No, you mustn't.'
items.analysis: must 提问时的否定回答要用 needn't 或 don't have to，表示“不必”；mustn't 意为“禁止、不许”，答非所问。这是 must 最常考的一个易错点。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with a modal verb: 你现在不必交作业，明天交也可以。
items.answer: You needn't hand in your homework now; you may hand it in tomorrow.
items.analysis: 否定回答“不必”用 needn't（或 don't have to），不能用 mustn't；后半句“可以”表许可，用 may。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with a modal verb: 他昨天一定读过这本书，因为他能回答所有问题。
items.answer: He must have read the book yesterday, for he could answer all the questions.
items.analysis: 对过去情况的肯定推测用 must have done；for 引导原因，说明推测依据。

items.stem: The light in his room is still on. He ______ be at home.
items.analysis: 灯还亮着，说话人有把握地推测“一定在家”，用 must be；can't 表示否定推测，与语境相反。

items.stem: You ______ have told her the news. She looks so sad now.
items.analysis: shouldn't have done 表示“本不该做而做了”，与 She looks so sad now 呼应。

items.stem: — Must I return the book today? — No, you ______ (not).
items.analysis: Must 引导的疑问句，否定回答用 needn't（不必），不能用 mustn't（禁止）。

items.stem: You ______ have told him the news—he had already known it.
items.analysis: needn't have done 表示“做了本来不必做的事”，与“他早就知道了”吻合。mustn't have done 不是规范用法；shouldn't have done 意为“本不该做（做了错事）”，语气是责备，此处重在“没有必要”；couldn't have done 表“不可能做过”。

items.stem: He must be in the classroom, ______?
items.analysis: must 表推测时，反意疑问句不重复 must，而要跟 must 之后的动词一致。本句 must be 中是系动词 be，主语 he，故用 isn't he。mustn't he 是机械重复情态动词的错误；doesn't he 与 be 动词不符。

items.stem: He dare not ______ out alone at night.
items.analysis: dare 在此作情态动词，与 not 连用时后接动词原形，故用 go。若 dare 作实义动词，则须说 doesn't dare to go，此时才带 to；to go 与 going 都不符合 dare not 的结构。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: You ______ (needn't, tell) her about it—she already knew the truth.
items.analysis: needn't have done 表示“做了本来不必做的事”，与“她早已知道真相”一致；tell sb. about sth. 结构保持不变。

items.stem: In 'You needn't have bought the tickets', the speaker means that the tickets were bought but it was not necessary.
items.analysis: needn't have done 表示动作已经发生，但本来没有必要，含有“白做了”的意味；若说 didn't need to buy，则通常表示没买。判断正确。

items.stem: She ______ have received my letter, otherwise she would have replied.
items.analysis: otherwise 说明与事实相反，对过去情况的否定推测用 can't have done；mustn't 不表推测。

items.stem: 判断：You needn't to worry about it. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: needn't 是情态动词，后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，应改为 needn't worry。

items.stem: If I ______ you, I would accept the offer.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句中 be 动词一律用 were，主句用 would + 动词原形。

items.stem: If it should rain tomorrow, we ______ at home.
items.analysis: if 从句用 should + 动词原形，表示与将来事实相反或可能性很小的假设，主句须用 would/could/might + 动词原形，故用 would stay。will stay 用于真实条件句；stayed 与 had stayed 时态与从句不匹配。

items.stem: If he ______ harder last term, he would have passed the exam.
items.analysis: 与过去事实相反：从句用 had + 过去分词，主句用 would have + 过去分词。worked 用于与现在相反；works 是陈述语气；would work 不能作 if 从句的谓语。

items.stem: If it ______ tomorrow, we would stay at home.
items.analysis: 与将来事实相反，从句用一般过去时 rained，主句用 would + 动词原形。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: If I ______ (be) you, I would apologize to her at once.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句中，be 动词一律用 were，主句用 would + 动词原形。

items.stem: If I ______ you, I would accept the offer without hesitation.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句谓语用过去式，be 动词一律用 were（正式书面语和考试规范），主句用 would + 动词原形。am 是陈述语气；was 在口语中偶见，但书面规范要求 were；had been 用于与过去相反，与“现在给你建议”的语境不符。

items.stem: If she ______ the answer, she would tell us.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反：从句用一般过去时 knew，主句用 would + 动词原形。knows 是陈述语气；had known 用于与过去相反；would know 不能出现在 if 从句中。

items.stem: I would go with you if I ______ time now.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反：if 从句用一般过去时 had，主句用 would + 动词原形。have 是真实条件；had had 用于与过去相反；will have 不能出现在条件从句中。

items.stem: If you had listened to me, you ______ the bus.
items.analysis: 与过去事实相反：从句用 had done，主句用 would have done，故为 wouldn't have missed。wouldn't miss 对应与现在相反；didn't miss 是陈述语气；hadn't missed 不能作主句谓语。

items.stem: But for the heavy rain, we ______ earlier.
items.analysis: but for 意为“要不是”，相当于 if it had not been for，是含蓄条件句，指过去未发生的情况，主句用 would have + 过去分词。would arrive 对应与现在或将来相反；arrived 与 had arrived 都不能构成虚拟主句。

items.stem: What ______ you do if you won a million yuan?
items.analysis: if 从句用 won（一般过去时）表示与现在/将来事实相反，主句须用 would + 动词原形，故用 would。will 用于真实条件句；did 与 had 都不能与 do 构成虚拟主句谓语。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the words in brackets: If he ______ (not, be) so careless, he wouldn't have made such a mistake.
items.analysis: 主句用 wouldn't have made，说明与过去事实相反，从句须用 had + 过去分词，其否定形式为 hadn't been。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: If you had come ten minutes earlier, you ______ (see) the famous writer.
items.analysis: 从句 had come 表示与过去事实相反，主句须用 would have + 过去分词，故填 would have seen。

items.stem: In 'If I were you, I would take the job', 'were' is used because the sentence describes a situation contrary to the present fact.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反的虚拟条件句，从句谓语用过去式，be 动词用 were，主句用 would + 动词原形，判断正确。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with the subjunctive mood: 如果我是你，我就会接受他的建议。
items.answer: If I were you, I would accept his advice.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反，if 从句用 were（不用 was），主句用 would + 动词原形；accept one's advice 意为“接受某人的建议”。

items.stem: Translate the sentence into English with the subjunctive mood: 如果你昨天早点出发，你就不会错过那班火车了。
items.answer: If you had set off earlier yesterday, you wouldn't have missed the train.
items.analysis: 与过去事实相反，从句用 had + 过去分词，主句用 would have + 过去分词；set off 意为“出发”，miss the train 意为“错过火车”。

items.stem: If he had taken my advice, he ______ that mistake.
items.analysis: 从句用 had taken 表与过去事实相反，主句用 wouldn't have done。

items.stem: ______ I known your address, I would have written to you.
items.analysis: 省略 if 的虚拟条件句把 had 提前构成倒装：Had I known...。

items.stem: If I ______ (know) her telephone number, I would call her right now.
items.analysis: 与现在事实相反，从句用一般过去时 knew，主句用 would call。

items.stem: If you had taken my advice then, you ______ in trouble now.
items.analysis: 这是混合虚拟：从句与过去事实相反（had taken），主句与现在事实相反（now），故主句用 would + 动词原形，即 wouldn't be。wouldn't have been 要求主句也指过去；won't be 是陈述语气；hadn't been 不能作主句谓语。

items.stem: If I ______ the chance, I would have gone abroad last year.
items.analysis: 与过去事实相反，从句须用 had + 过去分词；have 的过去分词是 had，故为 had had。只写 had 是一般过去时，用于与现在相反；have 是陈述语气；would have 不能出现在 if 从句中。

items.stem: Should it ______ tomorrow, the match would be put off.
items.analysis: 省略 if 的将来虚拟条件句把 should 提前，结构为 Should + 主语 + 动词原形，故用 rain。rains 是陈述语气；rained 用于与现在相反；would rain 不能跟在 should 之后。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: ______ (be) it not for your help, we would have given up long ago.
items.analysis: 这是省略 if 的倒装虚拟句，原句为 If it were not for your help，省略 if 后把 were 提前，句首字母须大写，故填 Were。

items.stem: 'If he had studied hard, he would pass the exam last term.' is a correct sentence.
items.analysis: 从句 had studied 表明与过去事实相反，主句也必须用 would have + 过去分词，应改为 he would have passed the exam last term。would pass 对应与现在或将来相反，与 last term 矛盾。

items.stem: I was busy with my report yesterday; otherwise I ______ you at the airport.
items.analysis: otherwise 引出含蓄条件，相当于 If I had not been busy with my report yesterday；条件与过去事实相反，主句用 would have done，故 would have met。would meet 是与现在相反的虚拟；met、had met 是陈述语气，不能表达虚拟结果。

items.stem: If you had followed the doctor's advice, you ______ much better now.
items.analysis: 混合虚拟：从句与过去事实相反用 had followed，主句因 now 而与现在事实相反，用 would feel。

items.stem: 用虚拟语气翻译：如果我昨天听了你的劝告，现在就不会陷入这样的麻烦。
items.answer: If I had taken your advice yesterday, I wouldn't be in such trouble now.
items.analysis: 从句与过去事实相反用 had done，主句与现在事实相反用 would do，now 与 yesterday 形成时态交叉的混合虚拟；taken 也可换成 followed。

items.stem: I wish I ______ as tall as my brother.
items.analysis: wish 后从句表示与现在事实相反的愿望，be 动词用 were。

items.stem: It is necessary that every student ___ the safety rules of the laboratory.
items.analysis: 在 It is necessary / important / strange that... 句型中，that 从句用虚拟语气 (should) do，不论主语是单数还是复数都用动词原形 follow。follows 是陈述语气，followed 与 following 都不能在此作谓语。

items.stem: ___ I you, I would apologize to her at once.
items.analysis: 省略 if 的虚拟条件句要把 were、had、should 提到句首构成倒装，Were I you 相当于 If I were you。am、was 不能用于该倒装结构，be 也不能直接放在句首作谓语。

items.stem: The teacher suggested that we ______ the experiment again.
items.analysis: suggest 表示“建议”时，从句用 (should) + 动词原形，should 可以省略。

items.stem: The teacher suggested that we ___ the experiment once more before writing the report.
items.analysis: suggest 表示“建议”时，其后的 that 从句要用虚拟语气，谓语为 should + 动词原形，should 可以省略，故填 do。did 是陈述语气；doing 只用于 suggest doing sth 结构；to do 不能作 suggest 的宾语。

items.stem: His doctor recommended that he ___ smoking immediately.
items.analysis: recommend 表示“建议”时，that 从句用 (should) do，主语 he 是第三人称单数也要用动词原形 stop。stops 是陈述语气；stopping 只用于 recommend doing sth；stopped 与虚拟语气要求不符。

items.stem: He talks as if he ___ everything, but in fact he knows very little.
items.analysis: as if 从句表示与现在事实相反时用一般过去时，故用 knew。had known 表示与过去事实相反，与前面 talks 的现在时间不一致；knows 是陈述语气；would know 多用于虚拟条件句主句。

items.stem: I wish I ___ my parents' advice last year.
items.analysis: wish 后的从句表示与过去事实相反的愿望时用过去完成时 had taken，last year 是明确的过去时间标志。took 只表示与现在相反；have taken 是陈述语气；would take 表示将来难以实现的愿望。

items.stem: But for your help, we ___ the task on time.
items.analysis: but for 意为“要不是”，暗含与过去事实相反的条件，主句用 would have done，故为 wouldn't have finished。wouldn't finish 对应现在或将来；didn't finish 与 hadn't finished 都不是虚拟主句形式。

items.stem: The manager demanded that the report ___ before Friday.
items.analysis: demand 后的 that 从句用虚拟语气 (should) be done；report 与 hand in 是被动关系，所以是 be handed in。is handed in 与 was handed in 是陈述语气，would be handed in 不是该句型的虚拟形式。

items.stem: I would rather ___ at home than go out in such weather.
items.analysis: would rather do sth than do sth 是固定结构，前后都用动词原形，故用 stay。would rather 后只有接从句时才用过去式，接动词时不能用 staying、to stay 或 stayed。

items.stem: ___ it not been for the traffic jam, we would have arrived earlier.
items.analysis: 这是省略 if 后倒装的虚拟条件句：Had it not been for... = If it had not been for...。Were 用于与现在事实相反的条件句，Should 用于与将来相反的条件句，If 不能直接引导这种省略倒装。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: I wish I ___ (know) the answer to this question now.
items.analysis: wish 后的从句表示与现在事实相反，谓语用一般过去时；now 说明说话人此刻的愿望，故用 knew。若与过去事实相反则用 had known。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with a proper preposition: But ___ your timely help, we would have failed the test.
items.analysis: but for 是固定搭配，意为“要不是”，后接名词或代词，相当于一个虚拟条件从句。不能换成 with、without 或 except。

items.stem: In the sentence “I wish I had studied harder”, the speaker is expressing regret about not having studied harder in the past.
items.analysis: wish 后接过去完成时表示与过去事实相反的愿望，实际上过去并没有更努力学习，因此这句话表达的是对过去的后悔。判断虚拟语气时，时态形式与事实相反是关键依据。

items.stem: Translate into English: 我建议你明天早点出发。
items.answer: I suggest that you (should) start early tomorrow.
items.analysis: suggest 表示“建议”时，宾语从句用虚拟语气 (should) do，should 可省略。若用 suggest doing 结构，则说 I suggest starting early tomorrow，但不能再带 you 作宾语。

items.stem: It is high time that we ______ something to protect the environment.
items.analysis: It is high time that ... 从句用一般过去时（或 should + 动词原形）表示虚拟，意为“早该做某事了”，故 did。do、will do、have done 都是陈述语气，不符合该句型的虚拟要求。

items.stem: It is necessary that every student ______ the rule.
items.analysis: It is necessary that... 主语从句用虚拟语气，即 (should) + 动词原形。

items.stem: I would rather you ______ tomorrow instead of today.
items.analysis: would rather 后接从句时，表示现在或将来用一般过去时，故用 came。

items.stem: He talks as if he ______ (be) an expert on the subject.
items.analysis: as if 从句表示与现在事实相反，be 动词用 were。

items.stem: He looked as though he ___ for days.
items.analysis: as though 从句表示与过去事实相反时用过去完成时；主句 looked 是过去时，说明“好几天没吃东西”发生在更早的过去，故用 hadn't eaten。doesn't eat 是陈述语气，didn't eat 只表示与现在相反。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: I would rather you ___ (tell) me the truth yesterday.
items.analysis: would rather 后接从句时用虚拟语气；yesterday 说明与过去事实相反，从句谓语用过去完成时 had told。与现在或将来相反时才用一般过去时 told。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: He acted as if nothing ___ (happen) between them.
items.analysis: as if 从句表示与过去事实相反时用过去完成时；nothing 与 happen 是主动关系，故为 had happened。若与现在事实相反则用一般过去时 happened。

items.stem: In “The smile on her face suggested that she was satisfied with the result”, “suggested” introduces a subjunctive clause, so “was” should be replaced by “be”.
items.analysis: suggest 表示“暗示、表明”时，后面的从句用陈述语气，不用虚拟语气，was 正确。只有 suggest 表示“建议”时，从句才用 (should) do。该句由“她脸上的笑容”可知是“表明”之意。

items.stem: Translate into English: 要是昨天听了他的建议，我现在就不会这么被动了。
items.answer: If I had taken his advice yesterday, I wouldn't be in such a difficult position now.
items.analysis: 这是混合虚拟句：从句与过去事实相反用 had done，主句与现在事实相反用 would do。yesterday 和 now 分别是两个时间标志，不能一律用 would have done 或一律用过去完成时。

items.stem: Which of the following sentences use the subjunctive mood correctly? (多选)
options: I wish I had studied harder last year.
It is important that he attends the meeting at once.
If I were you, I would apologize to her.
I would rather you didn't smoke here.
He suggested that we went there at once.
items.analysis: B 项 important 后的从句应用 (should) attend 或 attend；E 项 suggest 表建议，从句用 (should) go；A、C、D 三项虚拟形式正确。

items.stem: 判断：I wish I have more free time now. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: wish 从句表示与现在事实相反，应用一般过去时 had，不能用 have。

items.stem: I want ______ a doctor when I grow up.
items.analysis: want 后接不定式作宾语，构成 want to be...。

items.stem: You'd better ___ a doctor at once; your cough is getting worse.
items.analysis: had better do sth 是固定搭配，后面直接跟动词原形，故用 see，属于省略 to 的不定式。to see 多加了 to；seeing 与 saw 都不符合该结构。

items.stem: It is important ___ the instructions carefully before you use the machine.
items.analysis: It 是形式主语，真正的主语是不定式 to read，构成 It is + adj. + to do sth 句型。reading 不能作这里的真主语；read 缺 to；reads 是谓语形式。

items.stem: He decided ______ the job offer.
items.analysis: decide 后接不定式作宾语，decide to do sth。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: He promised ___ (help) me with my English every weekend.
items.analysis: promise 后接不定式作宾语，即 promise to do sth，故用 to help。promise doing 不是规范搭配，不能表示“答应做某事”。

items.stem: After thinking it over for a week, he decided ___ the job offer from the company.
items.analysis: decide 后接不定式作宾语，即 decide to do sth，故用 to accept。accepting 不能作 decide 的宾语；accept 缺 to；accepted 是过去分词或过去式，不能作宾语。

items.stem: My mother asked me ___ my room before I went out.
items.analysis: ask sb to do sth 是固定结构，用不定式作宾语补足语，故为 to clean。clean 缺 to；cleaning 表示主动进行，与“出去之前把房间收拾好”这一待完成动作不符；cleaned 是过去分词。

items.stem: The boy was made ___ the truth by his teacher.
items.analysis: make sb do sth 变为被动语态时，省略的 to 必须还原，即 be made to do sth，故用 to tell。tell 是主动语态中的形式；telling 与 told 都不符合 make 的搭配。

items.stem: I saw him ___ the street and enter a bookshop.
items.analysis: see sb do sth 表示看到动作的整个过程，与后面的 enter 并列，故用 cross。to cross 在主动语态的 see 后不带 to；crossing 强调正在进行，与 and enter 的完成意味不一致；crossed 不能作宾补。

items.stem: She has no friends ___ with in the new city.
items.analysis: 不定式作定语修饰 friends，talk with sb 中的介词 with 必须保留，构成 friends to talk with。talking 不能表示“可以交谈的朋友”这一未发生的动作；talked 与 talk 都不合语法。

items.stem: This math problem is too difficult ___ without a teacher.
items.analysis: too...to 结构中，不定式与主语 problem 构成动宾关系时，用主动形式表示被动意义，故用 to work out。to be worked out 在此结构中不自然；working out 与 work out 都不作状语。

items.stem: I'm sorry ___ you waiting for so long at the gate.
items.analysis: be sorry to have done sth 表示对已经发生的事表示歉意，keep sb waiting 的动作先于道歉，故用 to have kept。to keep 指将要发生；keeping 与 kept 都不作 sorry 的补足语。

items.stem: He would rather ___ than give in to those unreasonable demands.
items.analysis: would rather do sth than do sth 是固定结构，前后都用动词原形，故用 die。to die 多加了 to；dying 与 died 都不符合该结构。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: The little girl was made ___ (apologize) to her classmate.
items.analysis: make sb do sth 变为被动语态后要还原 to，即 be made to do sth，故填 to apologize。主动语态中才省略 to。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: This box is too heavy ___ (carry) upstairs by one person.
items.analysis: too...to 结构中，不定式与主语 box 构成动宾关系，用主动形式表被动意义，故填 to carry，后面不能再加 it。

items.stem: “I saw him enter the room” and “He was seen to enter the room” are both grammatically correct.
items.analysis: 主动语态中 see sb do sth 省略 to，变为被动语态后必须还原 to，即 be seen to do sth。两句都成立，只是语态不同。

items.stem: Translate into English: 他主动提出帮我搬这些箱子。
items.answer: He offered to help me carry these boxes.
items.analysis: offer 后接不定式作宾语，即 offer to do sth。“主动提出”不能译成 offer helping；help sb (to) do sth 中 to 可省略。

items.stem: The teacher told us ______ late again.
items.analysis: tell sb not to do sth，否定式把 not 放在 to 之前。

items.stem: He was made ______ the room after school.
items.analysis: make 的主动式接不带 to 的不定式，变为被动后须还原 to，即 be made to do。

items.stem: My parents didn't allow me ______ (go) out alone at night.
items.analysis: allow sb to do sth，此处用不定式作宾语补足语。

items.stem: We had no choice but ___ the truth to the police.
items.analysis: have no choice but to do sth 是固定搭配，but 前有实义动词 do 的某种形式时才省略 to；此处是名词 choice，故保留 to。tell、telling、told 都不符合该结构。

items.stem: The manager hurried to the airport, only ___ that the flight had been cancelled.
items.analysis: only to do 作结果状语，表示出乎意料的、令人失望的结果，故用 to find。finding 作结果状语多表示自然而然的结果；found 与 find 都不能与 only 构成该结构。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: He is said ___ (write) two novels so far.
items.analysis: be said to do 表示“据说”，so far 说明动作已经完成，不定式要用完成式 to have written。to write 只表示与谓语同时或之后发生的动作。

items.stem: In “He has nothing to worry”, the sentence is correct because “to worry” is used as an attributive modifying “nothing”.
items.analysis: worry 作不及物动词时必须带介词 about，应为 nothing to worry about。不定式作定语时，若动词是不及物动词，要保留其后的介词，否则句子不完整。

items.stem: Translate into English: 据说他已经完成了这项任务。
items.answer: He is said to have finished the task.
items.analysis: be said to do 表示“据说”，任务已完成，不定式用完成式 to have finished。若用 It is said that 句型，则从句用现在完成时：It is said that he has finished the task.

items.stem: The book is said ______ into five languages so far.
items.analysis: be said to do 结构中，不定式动作发生在谓语之前且为被动，用 to have been done。

items.stem: 判断：I had nothing to do but wait. 中 but 后的不定式省略 to，用法正确。
items.analysis: but/except 前有实义动词 do 时，其后的不定式省略 to，故用 wait 正确。

items.stem: I enjoy ______ to music in my free time.
items.analysis: enjoy 后接动名词作宾语，enjoy doing sth。

items.stem: He is used to ___ up early in the morning.
items.analysis: be used to 意为“习惯于”，其中 to 是介词，后接动名词，故用 getting。used to do 表示“过去常常”；be used to do 表示“被用来做”，两者都不能与 be used to doing 混用。

items.stem: It is no use ___ over spilt milk.
items.analysis: It is no use doing sth 是固定句型，it 为形式主语，动名词作真正主语，故用 crying。to cry 不能用于该句型；cry 与 cried 都不合语法。

items.stem: Would you mind ______ the window?
items.analysis: Would you mind doing...? 是固定搭配，mind 后接动名词。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: She is very good at ___ (sing) English songs.
items.analysis: be good at 中 at 是介词，后接动名词，故填 singing。介词后不能直接跟动词原形或不定式。

items.stem: Would you mind ___ the window? It's a little hot in here.
items.analysis: mind 后接动名词作宾语，即 mind doing sth，故用 opening。to open 是学生最常见的错误；open 与 opened 都不能作 mind 的宾语。

items.stem: He enjoys ___ to light music after a day's work.
items.analysis: enjoy 后只能接动名词作宾语，即 enjoy doing sth，故用 listening。to listen 是常犯错误；listen 与 listened 都不作 enjoy 的宾语。

items.stem: I look forward to ___ from you as soon as possible.
items.analysis: look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，故用 hearing。学生常误把 to 当不定式符号而用 hear；heard 与 be heard 同样不合该结构。

items.stem: He devotes most of his spare time to ___ the poor children in the village.
items.analysis: devote sth to doing sth 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，故用 helping。易误用 help 或 to help，是把 to 误认为不定式符号的典型错误。

items.stem: Do you remember ___ the door when you left the office?
items.analysis: remember doing sth 表示“记得做过某事”，动作已发生，与 when you left 的过去语境一致，故用 locking。remember to do 表示“记得要做”，指将来。

items.stem: Remember ___ me up at six tomorrow morning; I have an early train to catch.
items.analysis: remember to do sth 表示“记得去做某事”，动作尚未发生，tomorrow morning 说明是将来的事，故用 to wake。remember doing 指记得做过，与语境矛盾。

items.stem: The film is well worth ___ twice.
items.analysis: be worth doing sth 是固定搭配，worth 后接动名词，用主动形式表示被动意义，故用 seeing。to see、seen、see 都不能与 worth 搭配。

items.stem: He advised ___ an earlier train to avoid the rush hour.
items.analysis: advise doing sth 表示“建议做某事”，故用 taking。advise sb to do sth 中必须有宾语才能用不定式；此处没有 sb，用 to take 是常犯错误。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: She is looking forward to ___ (hear) from her son soon.
items.analysis: look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，故填 hearing。这是专升本考试中“to 作介词”的高频考点。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: He suggested ___ (hold) a meeting to discuss the plan.
items.analysis: suggest doing sth 表示“建议做某事”，故填 holding。suggest 后不能接不定式作宾语；若接从句则用 (should) do。

items.stem: “He stopped to smoke” means that he gave up smoking.
items.analysis: stop to do sth 表示“停下来去做另一件事”，即停下手中事去抽烟；stop doing sth 才表示“停止做某事”，如 stop smoking 才是戒烟。

items.stem: Translate into English: 他习惯于每天早起跑步。
items.answer: He is used to getting up early and running every day.
items.analysis: be used to doing sth 表示“习惯于做某事”，to 是介词，后接动名词；and 连接两个并列的动名词 getting 与 running。

items.stem: He is used to ______ early in the morning.
items.analysis: be used to 表示“习惯于”，to 是介词，后接动名词；used to do 才表示“过去常常”。

items.stem: It's no use ______ with him about it.
items.analysis: It's no use doing sth 是固定句型，用动名词作真正的主语。

items.stem: He devoted all his spare time to ______ (help) the poor children.
items.analysis: devote... to... 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 helping。

items.stem: Missing the last bus means ___ another hour for the next one.
items.analysis: mean doing sth 表示“意味着”，主语是物或某件事时用动名词，故用 waiting。mean to do 表示“打算做”，主语通常是人。

items.stem: I regret ___ you that your application has been refused.
items.analysis: regret to do sth 表示“遗憾地要做某事”，常用于 regret to say / tell / inform you；regret doing 表示“后悔做过某事”。此处是告知坏消息，故用 to tell。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: I still remember ___ (take) to the zoo by my father when I was five.
items.analysis: remember doing sth 表示“记得做过某事”，且 I 与 take 是被动关系，故用动名词的被动式 being taken。用 taking 会变成“我记得带别人去”，逻辑不通。

items.stem: “Would you mind my opening the window?” is correct because a possessive word can modify a gerund.
items.analysis: 动名词的复合结构可以由形容词性物主代词或名词所有格加动名词构成，my opening 即“我开窗”这件事。口语中也可用 me opening，但 my 更规范。

items.stem: Translate into English: 我很后悔当时没有听他的建议。
items.answer: I regret not having taken his advice then.
items.analysis: regret doing sth 表示“后悔做过某事”，否定形式为 not doing；动作先于 regret，可用完成式 not having taken。不能写成 regret not to take。

items.stem: I still remember ______ to the zoo by my father when I was five.
items.analysis: remember doing 表示“记得做过某事”；此处“被带去动物园”是被动，用 being taken。

items.stem: 判断：I'm looking forward to hear from you soon. 这句话语法正确。
items.analysis: look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，应改为 hearing。

items.stem: The girl ______ under the tree is my sister.
items.analysis: girl 与 sit 是主动关系且动作正在进行，用现在分词作后置定语。

items.stem: The man ___ with our teacher is a famous writer.
items.analysis: 现在分词 talking 作后置定语，相当于 who is talking，表示主动进行。talked 是过去分词，表被动；to talk 表将来；talk 不能作定语。

items.stem: He sat by the window, ___ at the passing cars.
items.analysis: 现在分词 looking 作伴随状语，表示与 sat 同时发生的主动动作。looked 表被动；to look 表目的，与“坐着”这一持续状态不搭配；look 不能作状语。

items.stem: ______ the news, she couldn't help crying.
items.analysis: hear 与句子主语 she 是主动关系，用现在分词作时间状语。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: ___ (see) the teacher coming, the students stopped talking.
items.analysis: 现在分词作时间状语，students 与 see 是主动关系，故用 Seeing，且位于句首首字母大写。Seen 表被动，逻辑不通。

items.stem: The girl ___ under the big tree is my younger sister.
items.analysis: 现在分词 standing 作后置定语，相当于 who is standing，表示主动、进行。stand 是谓语形式；stood 是过去分词，表被动；to stand 表将来，均不合。

items.stem: ___ along the street, I met an old friend of mine.
items.analysis: 现在分词 walking 作时间状语，其逻辑主语是句子主语 I，二者是主动关系。Walked 表被动；To walk 表目的；Walk 不能作状语。

items.stem: ___ that he was late, he hurried to the office.
items.analysis: 现在分词 knowing 作原因状语，he 与 know 是主动关系。Known 表被动；To know 表目的；Know 不能作状语。

items.stem: ___ the exam, he felt quite relaxed.
items.analysis: 考试先结束、放松后发生，现在分词完成式 having finished 表示动作先于谓语。Finished 表被动；To finish 表目的；Finish 不能作状语。

items.stem: The child fell off the bike, ___ his left leg.
items.analysis: 现在分词 breaking 作结果状语，表示自然而然的结果，child 与 break 是主动关系。broken 表被动；to break 表目的；break 不能作状语。

items.stem: The manager, ___ the report, asked for more details.
items.analysis: 现在分词完成式 having read 作状语，表示“看完报告”这一动作先于 asked。read 在此会被误读为过去式谓语；to read 表目的；reads 是谓语形式。

items.stem: ___ the news, she burst into tears.
items.analysis: 现在分词 hearing 作时间状语，she 与 hear 是主动关系。Heard 表被动；To hear 表目的；Hear 不能作状语。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: The girl ___ (dance) on the stage is from Class Two.
items.analysis: 现在分词作后置定语，相当于 who is dancing，表示主动进行，故填 dancing。danced 表被动或完成，与语境不符。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: ___ (work) in the factory for ten years, he knows the process very well.
items.analysis: 现在分词完成式作原因状语，表示“在工厂工作十年”先于 knows，故用 Having worked。Working 只表示同时进行。

items.stem: In “The news is exciting”, “exciting” is a present participle used as a predicative describing the news.
items.analysis: exciting 由现在分词转化而来，作表语说明主语 news 的性质，意为“令人激动的”。若用 excited 则说明人的感受，与本句主语不搭配。

items.stem: Translate into English: 听到这个消息，他们都跳了起来。
items.answer: Hearing the news, they all jumped up.
items.analysis: 现在分词 hearing 作时间状语，逻辑主语 they 与 hear 是主动关系，动作几乎同时发生。不能用 Heard，因为“他们”是被动听。

items.stem: ______ enough money with him, he had to give up the plan of buying the camera.
items.analysis: 现在分词的否定式要把 not 放在分词之前，故 Not having；Having not 语序错误。此处 have 表状态，用一般式即可，逻辑主语 he 与 have 是主动关系；Not had 是过去分词，表被动完成；Not to have 是不定式，不能作原因状语。

items.stem: The man ______ with the teacher is our new headmaster.
items.analysis: man 与 talk 是主动关系，用现在分词短语作后置定语。

items.stem: Not ______ what to do, he turned to his teacher for help.
items.analysis: know 与主语 he 是主动关系，否定词 not 置于分词之前。

items.stem: ______ (walk) along the street, I met an old friend of mine.
items.analysis: walk 与主语 I 是主动关系，用现在分词作时间状语。

items.stem: ___ the truth, he couldn't say a word.
items.analysis: 现在分词的否定式要把 not 放在分词之前，即 Not knowing。Not known 表被动；Don't know 是祈使句谓语；Not to know 是不定式否定式，不能作原因状语。

items.stem: There ___ no bus at that time, we had to walk home.
items.analysis: 这是 there be 结构的独立主格形式 there being，作原因状语。was 会与主句 had to 构成两个谓语；been 与 is 都不符合独立主格的要求。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: The meeting ___ (be) over, all the workers left the hall.
items.analysis: 这是独立主格结构：the meeting 是 being 的逻辑主语，会议“结束”与工人“离开”几乎同时，用现在分词 being。was 会造成两个谓语。

items.stem: In “Walking down the street, the shop caught my eye”, the sentence is acceptable because “walking” and “the shop” form a logical subject-predicate relation.
items.analysis: 现在分词作状语时，其逻辑主语必须与句子主语一致。走路的是“我”，不是 the shop，这属于悬垂分词，应改为 Walking down the street, I caught sight of the shop.

items.stem: Translate into English: 由于不知道他的地址，我们无法与他取得联系。
items.answer: Not knowing his address, we couldn't get in touch with him.
items.analysis: 现在分词的否定式是 not + 分词，置于句首；其逻辑主语 we 与 know 是主动关系。不能写成 Not known 或 Don't know。

items.stem: ______ his homework, he went out to play.
items.analysis: “完成作业”发生在 went out 之前，用现在分词的完成式 Having finished 表先发生的动作。

items.stem: 判断：Being ill, the doctor told him to stay in bed. 分词短语的逻辑主语与主句主语一致。
items.analysis: being ill 的逻辑主语应是 he，而主句主语是 the doctor，属垂悬分词，应改为 Being ill, he was told by the doctor to stay in bed。

items.stem: The bridge ______ in 2010 is still in good condition.
items.analysis: bridge 与 build 之间是被动关系，且 in 2010 说明动作已经完成，故用过去分词 built 作后置定语，相当于 which was built；being built 表示正在被建，与 in 2010 矛盾。

items.stem: The window ___ last night has been repaired.
items.analysis: window 与 break 是被动关系，last night 说明动作已完成，用过去分词 broken 作后置定语。breaking 表主动进行；broke 是谓语；to break 表将来。

items.stem: He had his hair ___ yesterday afternoon.
items.analysis: have sth done 表示“让某事被做”，hair 与 cut 是被动关系，故用过去分词 cut。cutting 表主动进行；to cut 与 cuts 都不符合该结构。

items.stem: ______ by the teacher's words, all the students worked harder than before.
items.analysis: 主语 students 与 encourage 是被动关系（学生受到鼓舞），用过去分词 Encouraged 作原因状语；现在分词表主动，与句意不符。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: The car ___ (repair) yesterday runs well now.
items.analysis: car 与 repair 是被动关系，yesterday 说明动作已完成，用过去分词 repaired 作后置定语，相当于 which was repaired yesterday。

items.stem: The book ___ by him last year sells very well among young readers.
items.analysis: book 与 write 是被动关系，且动作已由 last year 表明完成，用过去分词 written 作后置定语。writing 表主动进行；wrote 是谓语形式；to write 表将来且为主动。

items.stem: ___ in 1990, the school has trained thousands of talents.
items.analysis: school 与 found（创办）是被动关系，用过去分词 Founded 作时间状语。Founding 表主动；To found 表目的；Found 单独使用会被误读为谓语。

items.stem: ___ in a hurry, the letter had many spelling mistakes.
items.analysis: letter 与 write 是被动关系，用过去分词 Written 作原因状语。Writing 表主动，逻辑主语成了 letter，不通；To write 表目的；Write 不能作状语。

items.stem: The teacher stood there, ___ by his students.
items.analysis: teacher 与 surround 是被动关系，用过去分词 surrounded 作伴随状语。surrounding 表主动；to surround 表目的；surround 不能作状语。

items.stem: ___ from the moon, the earth looks like a blue ball.
items.analysis: earth 与 see 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen 作条件状语，相当于 If it is seen from the moon。Seeing 表主动；To see 表目的；See 不能作状语。

items.stem: ___ with the old one, the new machine works much better.
items.analysis: compare 与主语 machine 是被动关系，用过去分词 Compared 作状语，构成 compared with 固定搭配。Comparing 表主动，是典型错误；To compare 表目的；Compare 不能作状语。

items.stem: The problem ___ at yesterday's meeting is of great importance.
items.analysis: problem 与 discuss 是被动关系，且会议已在昨天开过，用过去分词 discussed 作后置定语。discussing 表主动；to discuss 表将来且为主动；discuss 不能作定语。

items.stem: The manager wants the letter ___ before noon.
items.analysis: want sth done 表示“希望某事被做”，letter 与 type 是被动关系，用过去分词 typed。typing 表主动；to type 与 type 都不能表示被动。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: ___ (give) more time, we could have done it better.
items.analysis: we 与 give 是被动关系（被给更多时间），用过去分词 Given 作条件状语，相当于 If we had been given more time。Giving 表主动。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: He sat by the fire, ___ (lose) in thought.
items.analysis: be lost in thought 意为“陷入沉思”，用过去分词 lost 作伴随状语，表示状态。losing 表主动，与“陷入沉思”的被动含义不符。

items.stem: In “a broken glass”, “broken” is a past participle used as an attributive with a passive meaning.
items.analysis: broken 由过去分词转化而来，作前置定语修饰 glass，表示“被打破的”，含被动、完成之意。这类词还有 a used car、a closed door。

items.stem: Translate into English: 由于出生在一个贫穷的家庭，他很小就不得不工作。
items.answer: Born into a poor family, he had to work at an early age.
items.analysis: born 是 bear 的过去分词，be born into 表示“出生于”，作原因状语，逻辑主语 he 与 born 是被动关系。不能写成 Borning 或 Bearing。

items.stem: The problem ______ at yesterday's meeting has not been solved yet.
items.analysis: problem 与 discuss 是被动关系，yesterday 表明讨论已经结束，用过去分词 discussed 作后置定语；being discussed 表示正在被讨论，与 yesterday 不符。

items.stem: ______ from the moon, the earth looks like a bright blue ball.
items.analysis: 地球是“被看”的对象，用过去分词 Seen 作条件状语，相当于 When the earth is seen from the moon。

items.stem: Most of the people ______ to the party were his old friends.
items.analysis: people 与 invite 是被动关系，过去分词 invited 作后置定语，相当于 who were invited；不定式 to invite 表将来且为主动，不合语境。

items.stem: ___ many times, he still couldn't understand the rule.
items.analysis: he 与 tell 是被动关系（别人告诉他很多次），用过去分词 Told 作让步状语，相当于 Though he had been told many times。Telling 表主动；Having told 表主动完成；To tell 表目的。

items.stem: His homework ___ , he went out to play with his friends.
items.analysis: 这是独立主格结构：homework 与 finish 是被动关系，用过去分词 finished。finishing 表主动；to finish 表将来；finish 不能作独立主格。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: ___ (not invite) to the party, she felt quite unhappy.
items.analysis: 过去分词的否定式是 not + 分词，置于句首且首字母大写；she 与 invite 是被动关系，故填 Not invited。

items.stem: In “Comparing with his brother, he is much taller”, the sentence is grammatically correct.
items.analysis: compare with 表示“与……相比”时，主语是被人拿来比较的对象，须用过去分词 Compared with...。用 Comparing 会变成“他比较……”，属于悬垂分词错误。

items.stem: Translate into English: 被老师表扬之后，那个男孩学习更加努力了。
items.answer: Praised by the teacher, the boy studied even harder.
items.analysis: 男孩与表扬是被动关系，用过去分词 Praised 作时间状语，相当于 After he was praised by the teacher。用 Praising 会变成男孩表扬别人。

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb in brackets: ______ (give) more time, we could have finished the task much better.
items.analysis: 这是省略 if 的条件状语，we 与 give 是被动关系，用过去分词 Given 作状语，相当于 If we had been given more time。

items.stem: Rewrite the sentence with a past participle phrase as the adverbial: Because he was deeply moved by the film, he decided to read the original novel.
items.answer: Deeply moved by the film, he decided to read the original novel.
items.analysis: 原因状语从句的主语 he 与 move 是被动关系，改为过去分词短语作状语；分词短语的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致，故保留 he 作主句主语。

items.stem: ___ from the top of the hill, the city looks beautiful.
items.analysis: 句子主语 the city 与 see 是被动关系（城市被人看），且与谓语 looks 同时发生，故用过去分词 Seen 作状语；Seeing 表主动，其逻辑主语应为人。

items.stem: The boy ___ football on the playground is my brother.
